11195.label: 2 Chronicles 1:1
11195.text: And Solʹo·mon the son of David continued to get strength in his kingship, and Jehovah his God was with him and kept making him surpassingly great.

11196.label: 2 Chronicles 1:2
11196.text: And Solʹo·mon proceeded to say the word to all Israel, to the chiefs of the thousands and of the hundreds and to the judges and to all the chieftains of all Israel, the heads of the paternal houses.

11197.label: 2 Chronicles 1:3
11197.text: Then Solʹo·mon and all the congregation with him went to the high place that was at Gibʹe·on; for there was where the tent of meeting of the [true] God, which Moses the servant of Jehovah had made in the wilderness, happened to be.

11198.label: 2 Chronicles 1:4
11198.text: However, the ark of the [true] God David had brought up from Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim to the place that David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

11199.label: 2 Chronicles 1:5
11199.text: And the copper altar that Bezʹal·el the son of Uʹri the son of Hur had made had been put before the tabernacle of Jehovah; and Solʹo·mon and the congregation applied as usual to it.

11200.label: 2 Chronicles 1:6
11200.text: Solʹo·mon now made offerings there before Jehovah upon the copper altar that belonged to the tent of meeting, and he proceeded to offer upon it a thousand burnt offerings.

11201.label: 2 Chronicles 1:7
11201.text: During that night God appeared to Solʹo·mon and then said to him: “Ask! What shall I give you?”

11202.label: 2 Chronicles 1:8
11202.text: At that Solʹo·mon said to God: “You are the One that exercised great loving-kindness toward David my father and that have made me king in place of him.

11203.label: 2 Chronicles 1:9
11203.text: Now, O Jehovah God, let your promise with David my father prove faithful, for you yourself have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust particles of the earth.

11204.label: 2 Chronicles 1:10
11204.text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge that I may go out before this people and that I may come in, for who could judge this great people of yours?”

11205.label: 2 Chronicles 1:11
11205.text: Then God said to Solʹo·mon: “For the reason that this has proved to be close to your heart and you have not asked for wealth, riches and honor or for the soul of those hating you, neither is it even many days that you have asked for, but you ask for wisdom and knowledge for yourself that you may judge my people over whom I have made you king,

11206.label: 2 Chronicles 1:12
11206.text: the wisdom and the knowledge are being given you; also wealth and riches and honor I shall give you such as no kings that were prior to you happened to have, and such as no one after you will come to have.”

11207.label: 2 Chronicles 1:13
11207.text: So Solʹo·mon came [from] the high place that was at Gibʹe·on, from before the tent of meeting, to Jerusalem and continued to reign over Israel.

11208.label: 2 Chronicles 1:14
11208.text: And Solʹo·mon kept gathering chariots and steeds so that he came to have a thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand steeds, and he kept them stationed in chariot cities and close by the king at Jerusalem.

11209.label: 2 Chronicles 1:15
11209.text: And the king came to make the silver and the gold in Jerusalem like the stones; and cedarwood he made like the sycamore trees that are in the She·pheʹlah for great quantity.

11210.label: 2 Chronicles 1:16
11210.text: And there was the export of the horses that Solʹo·mon had from Egypt, and the company of the king’s merchants would themselves take the horse drove for a price.

11211.label: 2 Chronicles 1:17
11211.text: And they customarily brought up and exported from Egypt a chariot for six hundred silver pieces and a horse for a hundred and fifty; and that was the way it was for all the kings of the Hitʹtites and the kings of Syria. It was by means of them that they did the exporting.

11212.label: 2 Chronicles 2:1
11212.text: Solʹo·mon now gave the word to build a house to Jehovah’s name and a house for his kingship.

11213.label: 2 Chronicles 2:2
11213.text: Accordingly Solʹo·mon counted off seventy thousand men as burden bearers and eighty thousand men as cutters in the mountain, and as overseers over them three thousand six hundred.

11214.label: 2 Chronicles 2:3
11214.text: Further, Solʹo·mon sent to Hiʹram the king of Tyre, saying: “Just as you dealt with David my father and you kept sending him cedarwood to build himself a house in which to dwell,—

11215.label: 2 Chronicles 2:4
11215.text: here I am building a house to the name of Jehovah my God to sanctify it to him, to burn perfumed incense before him, with the constant layer bread and burnt offerings in the morning and in the evening, on the sabbaths and on the new moons and at the festival seasons of Jehovah our God. To time indefinite this will be upon Israel.

11216.label: 2 Chronicles 2:5
11216.text: And the house that I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all the [other] gods.

11217.label: 2 Chronicles 2:6
11217.text: And who could retain power to build him a house? For the heavens and the heaven of the heavens cannot contain him, and who am I that I should build him a house except for making sacrificial smoke before him?

11218.label: 2 Chronicles 2:7
11218.text: And now send me a skillful man to work in gold and in silver and in copper and in iron and in wool dyed reddish purple and crimson and blue thread, and knowing how to cut engravings, along with the skillful ones that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father has prepared.

11219.label: 2 Chronicles 2:8
11219.text: And send me timbers of cedar, juniper and algum from Lebʹa·non, for I myself well know that your servants are experienced at cutting down the trees of Lebʹa·non, (and here my servants are together with your servants,)

11220.label: 2 Chronicles 2:9
11220.text: even for preparing timbers for me in great number, for the house that I am building will be great, yes, in a wonderful way.

11221.label: 2 Chronicles 2:10
11221.text: And, look! to the gatherers of wood, the cutters of the trees, I do give wheat as food for your servants, twenty thousand cors, and barley twenty thousand cors, and wine twenty thousand baths, and oil twenty thousand baths.”

11222.label: 2 Chronicles 2:11
11222.text: At that Hiʹram the king of Tyre said [the word] in writing and sent [it] to Solʹo·mon: “Because Jehovah loved his people he has constituted you king over them.”

11223.label: 2 Chronicles 2:12
11223.text: And Hiʹram went on to say: “Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth, because he has given to David the king a wise son, experienced in discretion and understanding, who will build a house to Jehovah and a house for his kingship.

11224.label: 2 Chronicles 2:13
11224.text: And now I do send a skillful man, experienced in understanding, belonging to Hiʹram-aʹbi,

11225.label: 2 Chronicles 2:14
11225.text: the son of a woman of the sons of Dan but whose father was a man of Tyre, experienced, to work in gold and in silver, in copper, in iron, in stones and in timbers, in wool dyed reddish purple, in blue thread and in fine fabric and in crimson and at cutting every sort of engraving and at designing every sort of device that may be given to him along with your own skillful men and the skillful men of my lord David your father.

11226.label: 2 Chronicles 2:15
11226.text: And now the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine that my lord has promised, let him send to his servants.

11227.label: 2 Chronicles 2:16
11227.text: As for ourselves, we shall cut down trees from Lebʹa·non according to all your need, and we shall bring them to you as rafts by sea to Jopʹpa, and you, for your part, will take them up to Jerusalem.”

11228.label: 2 Chronicles 2:17
11228.text: Then Solʹo·mon took a count of all the men that were alien residents, who were in the land of Israel, after the census that David his father had taken of them; and there came to be found a hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred.

11229.label: 2 Chronicles 2:18
11229.text: So he made seventy thousand of them burden bearers and eighty thousand cutters in the mountain and three thousand six hundred overseers for keeping the people in service.

11230.label: 2 Chronicles 3:1
11230.text: Finally Solʹo·mon started to build the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem on Mount Mo·riʹah, where [Jehovah] had appeared to David his father, in the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Orʹnan the Jebʹu·site.

11231.label: 2 Chronicles 3:2
11231.text: Accordingly he started to build in the second month on the second [day], in the fourth year of his reign.

11232.label: 2 Chronicles 3:3
11232.text: And these things Solʹo·mon laid as a foundation for building the house of the [true] God, the length in cubits by the former measurement being sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

11233.label: 2 Chronicles 3:4
11233.text: And the porch that was in front of the length was twenty cubits in front of the width of the house, and its height was a hundred and twenty; and he proceeded to overlay it inside with pure gold.

11234.label: 2 Chronicles 3:5
11234.text: And the great house he covered with juniper wood, after which he covered it with good gold, and then he brought up upon it palm-tree figures and chains.

11235.label: 2 Chronicles 3:6
11235.text: Further, he overlaid the house with precious stone for beauty; and the gold was gold from the gold country.

11236.label: 2 Chronicles 3:7
11236.text: And he went on to cover the house, the rafters, the thresholds and its walls and its doors with gold; and he engraved cherubs upon the walls.

11237.label: 2 Chronicles 3:8
11237.text: And he proceeded to make the house of the Most Holy, its length in relation to the width of the house being twenty cubits, and its own width being twenty cubits; and then he covered it with good gold to the amount of six hundred talents.

11238.label: 2 Chronicles 3:9
11238.text: And the weight for the nails was fifty gold shekels; and the roof chambers he covered with gold.

11239.label: 2 Chronicles 3:10
11239.text: Then he made in the house of the Most Holy two cherubs in the workmanship of images, and overlaid them with gold.

11240.label: 2 Chronicles 3:11
11240.text: As for the wings of the cherubs, their length was twenty cubits, the one wing of five cubits reaching to the wall of the house, and the other wing of five cubits reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

11241.label: 2 Chronicles 3:12
11241.text: And the wing of the one cherub of five cubits was reaching to the wall of the house, and the other wing of five cubits was in contact with the wing of the other cherub.

11242.label: 2 Chronicles 3:13
11242.text: The wings of these cherubs were spread out twenty cubits; and they were standing upon their feet with their faces inward.

11243.label: 2 Chronicles 3:14
11243.text: Further, he made the curtain of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and crimson and fine fabric, and worked in cherubs upon it.

11244.label: 2 Chronicles 3:15
11244.text: Then he made before the house two pillars, thirty-five cubits in length, and the capital that was upon the top of each one was five cubits.

11245.label: 2 Chronicles 3:16
11245.text: Further, he made chains in necklace style and put them upon the tops of the pillars, and made a hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.

11246.label: 2 Chronicles 3:17
11246.text: And he proceeded to set up the pillars in front of the temple, one to the right and one to the left, after which he called the name of the right-hand one Jaʹchin and the name of the left-hand one Boʹaz.

11247.label: 2 Chronicles 4:1
11247.text: Then he made the copper altar, twenty cubits being its length, and twenty cubits its width, and ten cubits its height.

11248.label: 2 Chronicles 4:2
11248.text: And he proceeded to make the molten sea ten cubits from its one brim to its other brim, circular all around, and its height was five cubits, and it took a line of thirty cubits to circle all around it.

11249.label: 2 Chronicles 4:3
11249.text: And there was the likeness of gourd-shaped ornaments under it clear around, surrounding it, ten in a cubit, enclosing the sea all around. The gourd-shaped ornaments were in two rows, being cast in its casting.

11250.label: 2 Chronicles 4:4
11250.text: It was standing upon twelve bulls, three facing the north and three facing the west and three facing the south and three facing the east; and the sea was above upon them, and all their hind parts were inward.

11251.label: 2 Chronicles 4:5
11251.text: And its thickness was a handbreadth; and its brim was like the workmanship of the brim of a cup, a lily blossom. As a receptacle, three thousand bath measures were what it could contain.

11252.label: 2 Chronicles 4:6
11252.text: Further, he made ten basins, and put five to the right and five to the left, to wash in them. Things having to do with the burnt offering they would rinse in them. But the sea was for the priests to wash in it.

11253.label: 2 Chronicles 4:7
11253.text: He then made lampstands of gold, ten of them of the same plan, and put them in the temple, five to the right and five to the left.

11254.label: 2 Chronicles 4:8
11254.text: Further, he made ten tables, and stationed them in the temple, five to the right and five to the left, and made a hundred bowls of gold.

11255.label: 2 Chronicles 4:9
11255.text: Then he made the courtyard of the priests and the great enclosure and the doors belonging to the enclosure, and their doors he overlaid with copper.

11256.label: 2 Chronicles 4:10
11256.text: And the sea he placed at the right side, to the east, toward the south.

11257.label: 2 Chronicles 4:11
11257.text: Finally Hiʹram made the cans and the shovels and the bowls. So Hiʹram finished doing the work that he did for King Solʹo·mon on the house of the [true] God.

11258.label: 2 Chronicles 4:12
11258.text: The two pillars and the round capitals upon the top of the two pillars and the two networks to cover the two round capitals that were upon the top of the pillars

11259.label: 2 Chronicles 4:13
11259.text: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, two rows of pomegranates for each network to cover the two round capitals that were upon the pillars,

11260.label: 2 Chronicles 4:14
11260.text: and the ten carriages and the ten basins upon the carriages;

11261.label: 2 Chronicles 4:15
11261.text: the one sea and the twelve bulls under it,

11262.label: 2 Chronicles 4:16
11262.text: and the cans and the shovels and the forks and all their utensils Hiʹram-aʹbiv made for King Solʹo·mon for the house of Jehovah, of polished copper.

11263.label: 2 Chronicles 4:17
11263.text: In the District of the Jordan the king cast them in the thick ground between Sucʹcoth and Zerʹe·dah.

11264.label: 2 Chronicles 4:18
11264.text: Thus Solʹo·mon made all these utensils in very great quantity, for the weight of the copper was not ascertained.

11265.label: 2 Chronicles 4:19
11265.text: And Solʹo·mon proceeded to make all the utensils that were at the house of the [true] God and the golden altar and the tables with the showbread upon them,

11266.label: 2 Chronicles 4:20
11266.text: and the lampstands and their lamps of pure gold, to light them up before the innermost room according to the rule;

11267.label: 2 Chronicles 4:21
11267.text: and the blossoms and the lamps and the snuffers, of gold, (it was the purest gold,)

11268.label: 2 Chronicles 4:22
11268.text: and the extinguishers and the bowls and the cups and the fire holders, of pure gold, and the entrance of the house, its inner doors for the Most Holy and the doors of the house of the temple, of gold.

11269.label: 2 Chronicles 5:1
11269.text: Finally all the work that Solʹo·mon had to do for the house of Jehovah was at its completion, and Solʹo·mon began to bring in the things made holy by David his father; and the silver and the gold and all the utensils he put in the treasures of the house of the [true] God.

11270.label: 2 Chronicles 5:2
11270.text: It was then that Solʹo·mon proceeded to congregate the older men of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the chieftains of the paternal houses of the sons of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah up from the City of David, that is to say, Zion.

11271.label: 2 Chronicles 5:3
11271.text: So all the men of Israel congregated themselves to the king at the festival, that of the seventh month.

11272.label: 2 Chronicles 5:4
11272.text: So all the older men of Israel came, and the Levites began to carry the Ark.

11273.label: 2 Chronicles 5:5
11273.text: And they came bringing up the Ark and the tent of meeting and all the holy utensils that were in the tent. The priests the Levites brought them up.

11274.label: 2 Chronicles 5:6
11274.text: And King Solʹo·mon and all the assembly of Israelites that were keeping their appointment with him before the Ark were sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

11275.label: 2 Chronicles 5:7
11275.text: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of Jehovah into its place, into the innermost room of the house, into the Most Holy, to underneath the wings of the cherubs.

11276.label: 2 Chronicles 5:8
11276.text: Thus the cherubs were continually spreading out their wings over the place of the Ark, so that the cherubs covered over the Ark and its poles from above.

11277.label: 2 Chronicles 5:9
11277.text: But the poles were long, so that the tips of the poles were visible at the Holy in front of the innermost room, but they were not visible outside, and they continue there down to this day.

11278.label: 2 Chronicles 5:10
11278.text: There was nothing in the Ark but the two tablets that Moses had given at Hoʹreb, when Jehovah covenanted with the sons of Israel while they were coming out from Egypt.

11279.label: 2 Chronicles 5:11
11279.text: And it came about when the priests came out from the holy place (for all the priests that were to be found had, for their part, sanctified themselves—there was no need to observe the divisions);

11280.label: 2 Chronicles 5:12
11280.text: and the Levites that were singers belonging to all of them, namely, to Aʹsaph, to Heʹman, to Je·duʹthun and to their sons and to their brothers clothed in fine fabric with cymbals and with stringed instruments and harps, were standing to the east of the altar and along with them priests to [the number of] a hundred and twenty sounding the trumpets;

11281.label: 2 Chronicles 5:13
11281.text: and it came about that as soon as the trumpeters and the singers were as one in causing one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Jehovah, and as soon as they lifted up the sound with the trumpets and with the cymbals and with the instruments of song and with praising Jehovah, “for he is good, for to time indefinite is his loving-kindness,” the house itself was filled with a cloud, the very house of Jehovah,

11282.label: 2 Chronicles 5:14
11282.text: and the priests were not able to stand to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of Jehovah filled the house of the [true] God.

11283.label: 2 Chronicles 6:1
11283.text: It was then that Solʹo·mon said: “Jehovah himself said he was to reside in the thick gloom;

11284.label: 2 Chronicles 6:2
11284.text: and I, for my part, have built a house of lofty abode for you and an established place for you to dwell in to time indefinite.”

11285.label: 2 Chronicles 6:3
11285.text: Then the king turned his face and began to bless all the congregation of Israel, while all the congregation of Israel were standing up.

11286.label: 2 Chronicles 6:4
11286.text: And he went on to say: “Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, who spoke with his own mouth with David my father and by his own hands has given fulfillment, saying,

11287.label: 2 Chronicles 6:5
11287.text: ‘From the day that I brought my people out from the land of Egypt I have not chosen a city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house for my name to prove to be there, and I have not chosen a man to become leader over my people Israel.

11288.label: 2 Chronicles 6:6
11288.text: But I shall choose Jerusalem for my name to prove to be there, and I shall choose David to come to be over my people Israel.’

11289.label: 2 Chronicles 6:7
11289.text: And it came to be close to the heart of David my father to build a house to the name of Jehovah the God of Israel.

11290.label: 2 Chronicles 6:8
11290.text: But Jehovah said to David my father, ‘For the reason that it proved to be close to your heart to build a house to my name, you did well because it proved to be close to your heart.

11291.label: 2 Chronicles 6:9
11291.text: Only you yourself will not build the house, but your son who is coming forth from your loins is the one that will build the house to my name.’

11292.label: 2 Chronicles 6:10
11292.text: And Jehovah proceeded to carry out his word that he had spoken, that I might rise up in the place of David my father and sit upon the throne of Israel, just as Jehovah had spoken, and that I might build the house to the name of Jehovah the God of Israel,

11293.label: 2 Chronicles 6:11
11293.text: and that I might place there the ark where the covenant of Jehovah is that he concluded with the sons of Israel.”

11294.label: 2 Chronicles 6:12
11294.text: And he began standing before the altar of Jehovah in front of all the congregation of Israel, and he now spread out his palms.

11295.label: 2 Chronicles 6:13
11295.text: (For Solʹo·mon had made a platform of copper and then put it in the middle of the enclosure. Its length was five cubits, and its width five cubits, and its height three cubits; and he kept standing upon it.) And he proceeded to kneel upon his knees in front of all the congregation of Israel and to spread his palms out to the heavens.

11296.label: 2 Chronicles 6:14
11296.text: And he went on to say: “O Jehovah the God of Israel, there is no God like you in the heavens or on the earth, keeping the covenant and the loving-kindness toward your servants who are walking before you with all their heart;

11297.label: 2 Chronicles 6:15
11297.text: you who have kept toward your servant David my father what you promised him, so that you made the promise with your mouth, and with your own hand you have made fulfillment as at this day.

11298.label: 2 Chronicles 6:16
11298.text: And now, O Jehovah the God of Israel, keep toward your servant David my father what you promised him, saying, ‘There will not be cut off a man of yours from before me to sit upon the throne of Israel, if only your sons will take care of their way by walking in my law, just as you have walked before me.’

11299.label: 2 Chronicles 6:17
11299.text: And now, O Jehovah the God of Israel, let your promise that you have promised to your servant David prove trustworthy.

11300.label: 2 Chronicles 6:18
11300.text: “But will God truly dwell with mankind upon the earth? Look! Heaven, yes, the heaven of the heavens themselves, cannot contain you; how much less, then, this house that I have built?

11301.label: 2 Chronicles 6:19
11301.text: And you must turn toward the prayer of your servant and to his request for favor, O Jehovah my God, by listening to the entreating cry and to the prayer with which your servant is praying before you,

11302.label: 2 Chronicles 6:20
11302.text: that your eyes may prove to be opened toward this house day and night, toward the place where you said you would put your name, by listening to the prayer with which your servant prays toward this place.

11303.label: 2 Chronicles 6:21
11303.text: And you must listen to the entreaties of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place, that you yourself may hear from the place of your dwelling, from the heavens; and you must hear and forgive.

11304.label: 2 Chronicles 6:22
11304.text: “If a man sins against his fellowman and he actually lays a cursing upon him to bring him under liability to the curse, and he actually comes [within] the curse before your altar in this house,

11305.label: 2 Chronicles 6:23
11305.text: then may you yourself hear from the heavens, and you must act and judge your servants so as to pay back the wicked by putting his course upon his own head and by pronouncing the righteous one righteous by giving to him according to his own righteousness.

11306.label: 2 Chronicles 6:24
11306.text: “And if your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they kept sinning against you, and they indeed return and laud your name and pray and make request for favor before you in this house,

11307.label: 2 Chronicles 6:25
11307.text: then may you yourself hear from the heavens, and you must forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the ground that you gave to them and their forefathers.

11308.label: 2 Chronicles 6:26
11308.text: “When the heavens are shut up so that no rain occurs because they kept sinning against you, and they actually pray toward this place and laud your name [and] from their sin they turn back because you kept afflicting them,

11309.label: 2 Chronicles 6:27
11309.text: then may you yourself hear from the heavens, and you must forgive the sin of your servants, even of your people Israel, because you instruct them regarding the good way in which they should walk; and you must give rain upon your land that you have given to your people as a hereditary possession.

11310.label: 2 Chronicles 6:28
11310.text: “In case a famine occurs in the land, in case a pestilence occurs, in case scorching and mildew, locusts and cockroaches occur; in case their enemies besiege them in the land of their gates —any sort of plague and any sort of malady —

11311.label: 2 Chronicles 6:29
11311.text: whatever prayer, whatever request for favor there may occur on the part of any man or of all your people Israel, because they know each one his own plague and his own pain; when he actually spreads out his palms toward this house,

11312.label: 2 Chronicles 6:30
11312.text: then may you yourself hear from the heavens, the place of your dwelling, and you must forgive and give to each one according to all his ways, because you know his heart (for you yourself alone well know the heart of the sons of mankind);

11313.label: 2 Chronicles 6:31
11313.text: to the end that they may fear you by walking in your ways all the days that they are alive upon the surface of the ground that you gave to our forefathers.

11314.label: 2 Chronicles 6:32
11314.text: “And also to the foreigner who is no part of your people Israel and who actually comes from a distant land by reason of your great name and your strong hand and your stretched-out arm, and they actually come and pray toward this house,

11315.label: 2 Chronicles 6:33
11315.text: then may you yourself listen from the heavens, from your established place of dwelling, and you must do according to all for which the foreigner calls to you; in order that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and may fear you the same as your people Israel do, and may know that your name has been called upon this house that I have built.

11316.label: 2 Chronicles 6:34
11316.text: “In case your people go out to the war against their enemies in the way that you send them, and they indeed pray to you in the direction of this city that you have chosen and the house that I have built to your name,

11317.label: 2 Chronicles 6:35
11317.text: you must also hear from the heavens their prayer and their request for favor, and you must execute judgment for them.

11318.label: 2 Chronicles 6:36
11318.text: “In case they sin against you (for there is no man that does not sin), and you have to be incensed at them and abandon them to an enemy, and their captors actually carry them off captive to a land distant or nearby;

11319.label: 2 Chronicles 6:37
11319.text: and they indeed come to their senses in the land where they have been carried off captive, and they actually return and make request to you for favor in the land where they are captives, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have erred and we have acted wickedly’;

11320.label: 2 Chronicles 6:38
11320.text: and they indeed return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land where they are captives of those who carried them off captive, and they indeed pray in the direction of their land that you gave to their forefathers and the city that you have chosen and the house that I have built to your name;

11321.label: 2 Chronicles 6:39
11321.text: you must also hear from the heavens, from your established place of dwelling, their prayer and their requests for favor, and you must execute judgment for them and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

11322.label: 2 Chronicles 6:40
11322.text: “Now, O my God, please, let your eyes prove to be opened and your ears attentive to the prayer respecting this place.

11323.label: 2 Chronicles 6:41
11323.text: And now do rise up, O Jehovah God, into your rest, you and the Ark of your strength. Let your priests themselves, O Jehovah God, be clothed with salvation, and let your loyal ones themselves rejoice in goodness.

11324.label: 2 Chronicles 6:42
11324.text: O Jehovah God, do not turn back the face of your anointed one. O do remember the loving-kindnesses to David your servant.”

11325.label: 2 Chronicles 7:1
11325.text: Now as soon as Solʹo·mon finished praying, the fire itself came down from the heavens and proceeded to consume the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and Jehovah’s glory itself filled the house.

11326.label: 2 Chronicles 7:2
11326.text: And the priests were unable to enter into the house of Jehovah because Jehovah’s glory had filled the house of Jehovah.

11327.label: 2 Chronicles 7:3
11327.text: And all the sons of Israel were spectators when the fire came down and the glory of Jehovah was upon the house, and they immediately bowed low with their faces to the earth upon the pavement and prostrated themselves and thanked Jehovah, “for he is good, for his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.”

11328.label: 2 Chronicles 7:4
11328.text: And the king and all the people were offering sacrifice before Jehovah.

11329.label: 2 Chronicles 7:5
11329.text: And King Solʹo·mon went on offering the sacrifice of twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. Thus the king and all the people inaugurated the house of the [true] God.

11330.label: 2 Chronicles 7:6
11330.text: And the priests were standing at their posts of duty, and the Levites with the instruments of song to Jehovah that David the king had made to thank Jehovah, “for his loving-kindness is to time indefinite,” when David would render praise by their hand; and the priests were loudly sounding the trumpets in front of them, while all the Israelites were standing.

11331.label: 2 Chronicles 7:7
11331.text: Then Solʹo·mon sanctified the middle of the courtyard that was before the house of Jehovah, because there he rendered up the burnt offerings and the fat pieces of the communion sacrifices, for the copper altar that Solʹo·mon had made was itself not able to contain the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat pieces.

11332.label: 2 Chronicles 7:8
11332.text: And Solʹo·mon proceeded to hold the festival at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation from the entering in of Haʹmath down to the torrent valley of Egypt.

11333.label: 2 Chronicles 7:9
11333.text: But on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, because the inauguration of the altar they had held for seven days and the festival for seven days.

11334.label: 2 Chronicles 7:10
11334.text: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their homes, joyful and feeling good at heart over the goodness that Jehovah had performed toward David and toward Solʹo·mon and toward Israel his people.

11335.label: 2 Chronicles 7:11
11335.text: Thus Solʹo·mon finished the house of Jehovah and the house of the king; and in everything that had come into Solʹo·mon’s heart to do regarding the house of Jehovah and his own house he proved successful.

11336.label: 2 Chronicles 7:12
11336.text: Jehovah now appeared to Solʹo·mon during the night and said to him: “I have heard your prayer, and I have chosen this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.

11337.label: 2 Chronicles 7:13
11337.text: When I shut up the heavens that no rain may occur and when I command the grasshoppers to eat up the land and if I send a pestilence among my people,

11338.label: 2 Chronicles 7:14
11338.text: and my people upon whom my name has been called humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn back from their bad ways, then I myself shall hear from the heavens and forgive their sin, and I shall heal their land.

11339.label: 2 Chronicles 7:15
11339.text: Now my own eyes will prove to be opened and my ears attentive to prayer at this place.

11340.label: 2 Chronicles 7:16
11340.text: And now I do choose and sanctify this house that my name may prove to be there to time indefinite, and my eyes and my heart will certainly prove to be there always.

11341.label: 2 Chronicles 7:17
11341.text: “And if you yourself will walk before me, just as David your father walked, even by doing according to all that I have commanded you, and you will keep my regulations and my judicial decisions,

11342.label: 2 Chronicles 7:18
11342.text: I will also establish the throne of your kingship, just as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There will not a man of yours be cut off from ruling over Israel.’

11343.label: 2 Chronicles 7:19
11343.text: But if YOU yourselves turn back and actually leave my statutes and my commandments that I have put before YOU, and YOU actually go and serve other gods and bow down to them,

11344.label: 2 Chronicles 7:20
11344.text: I will also uproot them from off my ground that I have given them; and this house that I have sanctified for my name, I shall throw away from before my face, and I shall make it a proverbial saying and a taunt among all the peoples.

11345.label: 2 Chronicles 7:21
11345.text: As for this house that had become heaps of ruins, everyone passing by it will stare in amazement and be certain to say, ‘For what reason did Jehovah do like that to this land and to this house?’

11346.label: 2 Chronicles 7:22
11346.text: And they will have to say, ‘It was for the reason that they left Jehovah the God of their forefathers who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they proceeded to take hold of other gods and bow down to them and serve them. That is why he brought upon them all this calamity.’”

11347.label: 2 Chronicles 8:1
11347.text: And it came about at the end of twenty years, in which Solʹo·mon had built the house of Jehovah and his own house,

11348.label: 2 Chronicles 8:2
11348.text: that the cities that Hiʹram had given to Solʹo·mon—Solʹo·mon rebuilt them and then caused the sons of Israel to dwell there.

11349.label: 2 Chronicles 8:3
11349.text: Furthermore, Solʹo·mon went to Haʹmath-zoʹbah and prevailed over it.

11350.label: 2 Chronicles 8:4
11350.text: Then he rebuilt Tadʹmor in the wilderness and all the storage cities that he had built in Haʹmath.

11351.label: 2 Chronicles 8:5
11351.text: And he went on to build Upper Beth-hoʹron and Lower Beth-hoʹron, fortified cities with walls, doors and bar,

11352.label: 2 Chronicles 8:6
11352.text: and Baʹal·ath and all the storage cities that had become Solʹo·mon’s and all the chariot cities and the cities for the horsemen and every desirable thing of Solʹo·mon that he had desired to build in Jerusalem and in Lebʹa·non and in all the land of his dominion.

11353.label: 2 Chronicles 8:7
11353.text: As for all the people that were left over of the Hitʹtites and the Amʹor·ites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites, who were no part of Israel,

11354.label: 2 Chronicles 8:8
11354.text: from their sons that had been left behind them in the land, whom the sons of Israel had not exterminated, Solʹo·mon kept levying men for forced labor until this day.

11355.label: 2 Chronicles 8:9
11355.text: But there were none out of the sons of Israel that Solʹo·mon constituted slaves for his work; for they were warriors and chiefs of his adjutants and chiefs of his charioteers and of his horsemen.

11356.label: 2 Chronicles 8:10
11356.text: These were the chiefs of the deputies that belonged to King Solʹo·mon, two hundred and fifty, the foremen over the people.

11357.label: 2 Chronicles 8:11
11357.text: And Pharʹaoh’s daughter Solʹo·mon brought up out of the City of David to the house that he had built for her, for he said: “Although a wife of mine, she should not dwell in the house of David the king of Israel, for the places to which the ark of Jehovah has come are something holy.”

11358.label: 2 Chronicles 8:12
11358.text: It was then that Solʹo·mon offered up burnt sacrifices to Jehovah upon the altar of Jehovah that he had built before the porch,

11359.label: 2 Chronicles 8:13
11359.text: even as a daily matter of course to make offerings according to the commandment of Moses for the sabbaths and for the new moons and for the appointed festivals three times in the year, at the festival of unfermented cakes and at the festival of the weeks and at the festival of the booths.

11360.label: 2 Chronicles 8:14
11360.text: Further, he set the divisions of the priests over their services according to the rule of David his father, and the Levites at their posts of duty, to praise and to minister in front of the priests as a daily matter of course, and the gatekeepers in their divisions for the different gates, for such was the commandment of David the man of the [true] God.

11361.label: 2 Chronicles 8:15
11361.text: And they did not turn aside from the king’s commandment to the priests and the Levites concerning any matter and concerning the supplies.

11362.label: 2 Chronicles 8:16
11362.text: So Solʹo·mon’s work was all in a prepared state from the day of the foundation-laying of the house of Jehovah until it was finished. [So] the house of Jehovah was complete.

11363.label: 2 Chronicles 8:17
11363.text: It was then that Solʹo·mon went to Eʹzi·on-geʹber and to Eʹloth upon the shore of the sea in the land of Eʹdom.

11364.label: 2 Chronicles 8:18
11364.text: And Hiʹram regularly sent to him by means of his servants ships and servants having a knowledge of the sea, and they would come with Solʹo·mon’s servants to Oʹphir and take from there four hundred and fifty talents of gold and bring it to King Solʹo·mon.

11365.label: 2 Chronicles 9:1
11365.text: And the queen of Sheʹba herself heard the report about Solʹo·mon, and she proceeded to come to test Solʹo·mon with perplexing questions at Jerusalem, along with a very impressive train and camels carrying balsam oil, and gold in great quantity, and precious stones. At length she came in to Solʹo·mon and spoke with him about everything that happened to be close to her heart.

11366.label: 2 Chronicles 9:2
11366.text: Solʹo·mon, in turn, went on to tell her all her matters, and no matter was hidden from Solʹo·mon that he did not tell her.

11367.label: 2 Chronicles 9:3
11367.text: When the queen of Sheʹba got to see Solʹo·mon’s wisdom and the house that he had built,

11368.label: 2 Chronicles 9:4
11368.text: and the food of his table and the sitting of his servants and the table service of his waiters and their attire and his drinking service and their attire, and his burnt sacrifices that he regularly offered up at the house of Jehovah, then there proved to be no more spirit in her.

11369.label: 2 Chronicles 9:5
11369.text: So she said to the king: “True was the word that I heard in my own land about your matters and about your wisdom.

11370.label: 2 Chronicles 9:6
11370.text: And I did not put faith in their words until I had come that my own eyes might see; and, look! there has not been told me the half of the abundance of your wisdom. You have surpassed the report that I have heard.

11371.label: 2 Chronicles 9:7
11371.text: Happy are your men, and happy are these servants of yours who are standing before you constantly and listening to your wisdom.

11372.label: 2 Chronicles 9:8
11372.text: May Jehovah your God come to be blessed, who has taken delight in you by putting you upon his throne as king for Jehovah your God; because your God loved Israel, to make it stand to time indefinite, so that he put you over them as king to execute judicial decision and righteousness.”

11373.label: 2 Chronicles 9:9
11373.text: Then she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and balsam oil in very great quantity, and precious stones; and there had not come to be the like of that balsam oil which the queen of Sheʹba gave to King Solʹo·mon.

11374.label: 2 Chronicles 9:10
11374.text: And, besides, the servants of Hiʹram and the servants of Solʹo·mon who brought gold from Oʹphir brought timbers of algum trees and precious stones.

11375.label: 2 Chronicles 9:11
11375.text: And the king proceeded to make out of the timbers of the algum trees stairs for the house of Jehovah and for the king’s house and also harps and stringed instruments for the singers, and the like of them had never been seen before in the land of Judah.

11376.label: 2 Chronicles 9:12
11376.text: And King Solʹo·mon himself gave the queen of Sheʹba all her delight for which she had asked, besides [the value of] what she brought to the king. So she turned about and went to her own land, she together with her servants.

11377.label: 2 Chronicles 9:13
11377.text: And the weight of the gold that came to Solʹo·mon in one year amounted to six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,

11378.label: 2 Chronicles 9:14
11378.text: aside from the men of travel and the merchants who were bringing in and all the kings of the Arabs and the governors of the land who were bringing in gold and silver to Solʹo·mon.

11379.label: 2 Chronicles 9:15
11379.text: And King Solʹo·mon went on to make two hundred large shields of alloyed gold (six hundred [shekels] of alloyed gold he proceeded to lay upon each large shield),

11380.label: 2 Chronicles 9:16
11380.text: and three hundred bucklers of alloyed gold (three miʹnas of gold he proceeded to lay upon each buckler). Then the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebʹa·non.

11381.label: 2 Chronicles 9:17
11381.text: Further, the king made a great ivory throne and overlaid it with pure gold.

11382.label: 2 Chronicles 9:18
11382.text: And there were six steps to the throne, and there was a footstool in gold to the throne (they were attached), and there were armrests on this side and on that side by the place of sitting, and two lions were standing beside the armrests.

11383.label: 2 Chronicles 9:19
11383.text: And there were twelve lions standing there upon the six steps on this side and on that side. No other kingdom had any made just like it.

11384.label: 2 Chronicles 9:20
11384.text: And all the drinking vessels of King Solʹo·mon were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebʹa·non were of pure gold. There was nothing of silver; it was considered as nothing at all in the days of Solʹo·mon.

11385.label: 2 Chronicles 9:21
11385.text: For ships belonging to the king were going to Tarʹshish with the servants of Hiʹram. Once every three years ships of Tarʹshish would come in, carrying gold and silver, ivory, and apes and peacocks.

11386.label: 2 Chronicles 9:22
11386.text: So King Solʹo·mon was greater than all the other kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

11387.label: 2 Chronicles 9:23
11387.text: And all the kings of the earth were seeking the face of Solʹo·mon to hear his wisdom, which the [true] God had put in his heart.

11388.label: 2 Chronicles 9:24
11388.text: And they were bringing each his gift, articles of silver and articles of gold and garments, armor and balsam oil, horses and mules as a yearly matter of course.

11389.label: 2 Chronicles 9:25
11389.text: And Solʹo·mon came to have four thousand stalls of horses and chariots and twelve thousand steeds, and he kept them stationed in the chariot cities and close by the king in Jerusalem.

11390.label: 2 Chronicles 9:26
11390.text: And he came to be ruler over all the kings from the River down to the land of the Phi·lisʹtines and down to the boundary of Egypt.

11391.label: 2 Chronicles 9:27
11391.text: Furthermore, the king made the silver in Jerusalem like the stones; and cedarwood he made like the sycamore trees that are in the She·pheʹlah for abundance.

11392.label: 2 Chronicles 9:28
11392.text: And there were those bringing out horses to Solʹo·mon from Egypt and from all the other lands.

11393.label: 2 Chronicles 9:29
11393.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Solʹo·mon, the first and the last, are they not written among the words of Nathan the prophet and in the prophecy of A·hiʹjah the Shiʹlo·nite and in the record of visions of Idʹdo the visionary concerning Jer·o·boʹam the son of Neʹbat?

11394.label: 2 Chronicles 9:30
11394.text: And Solʹo·mon continued to reign in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.

11395.label: 2 Chronicles 9:31
11395.text: Finally Solʹo·mon lay down with his forefathers. So they buried him in the City of David his father; and Re·ho·boʹam his son began to reign in place of him.

11396.label: 2 Chronicles 10:1
11396.text: And Re·ho·boʹam proceeded to go to Sheʹchem, for it was to Sheʹchem that all the Israelites came to make him king.

11397.label: 2 Chronicles 10:2
11397.text: And it came about that as soon as Jer·o·boʹam the son of Neʹbat heard of it while he was yet in Egypt, (because he had run away on account of Solʹo·mon the king,) Jer·o·boʹam immediately came back from Egypt.

11398.label: 2 Chronicles 10:3
11398.text: So they sent and called him, and Jer·o·boʹam and all Israel came and spoke to Re·ho·boʹam, saying:

11399.label: 2 Chronicles 10:4
11399.text: “Your father, for his part, made our yoke hard; and now make the hard service of your father and the heavy yoke that he put upon us lighter, and we shall serve you.”

11400.label: 2 Chronicles 10:5
11400.text: At this he said to them: “Let there be yet three days. Then return to me.” So the people went away.

11401.label: 2 Chronicles 10:6
11401.text: And King Re·ho·boʹam began to take counsel with the older men that were continually attending upon Solʹo·mon his father while he continued alive, saying: “How are YOU advising to reply to this people?”

11402.label: 2 Chronicles 10:7
11402.text: Accordingly they spoke to him, saying: “If you would prove yourself good to this people and actually be pleasing to them and indeed speak good words to them, they also will certainly become your servants always.”

11403.label: 2 Chronicles 10:8
11403.text: However, he left the counsel of the older men with which they had advised him, and he began to take counsel with the young men that had grown up with him, who were the ones attending upon him.

11404.label: 2 Chronicles 10:9
11404.text: And he went on to say to them: “What is it that YOU are offering in counsel that we may reply to this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put upon us lighter’?”

11405.label: 2 Chronicles 10:10
11405.text: In turn the young men that had grown up with him spoke with him, saying: “This is what you should say to the people who have spoken to you, saying, ‘Your father, for his part, made our yoke heavy, but, as for you, make it lighter upon us’; this is what you should say to them, ‘My own little finger will certainly be thicker than my father’s hips.

11406.label: 2 Chronicles 10:11
11406.text: And now my father, for his part, loaded upon YOU a heavy yoke, but I, for my part, shall add to YOUR yoke. My father, for his part, chastised YOU with whips, but I, for my part, with scourges.’”

11407.label: 2 Chronicles 10:12
11407.text: And Jer·o·boʹam and all the people proceeded to come to Re·ho·boʹam on the third day, just as the king had spoken, saying: “Return to me on the third day.”

11408.label: 2 Chronicles 10:13
11408.text: And the king began to answer them harshly. Thus King Re·ho·boʹam left the counsel of the older men,

11409.label: 2 Chronicles 10:14
11409.text: and he went on to speak to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying: “I shall make YOUR yoke heavier, and I, for my part, shall add to it. My father, for his part, chastised YOU with whips, but I, for my part, with scourges.”

11410.label: 2 Chronicles 10:15
11410.text: And the king did not listen to the people; for it proved to be a turn of affairs from the [true] God in order that Jehovah might carry out his word that he had spoken by means of A·hiʹjah the Shiʹlo·nite to Jer·o·boʹam the son of Neʹbat.

11411.label: 2 Chronicles 10:16
11411.text: As for all Israel, because the king did not listen to them, the people now replied to the king, saying: “What share do we have in David? And there is no inheritance in the son of Jesʹse. Each one to your gods, O Israel! Now see to your own house, O David.” With that all Israel began to go to its tents.

11412.label: 2 Chronicles 10:17
11412.text: As for the sons of Israel that were dwelling in the cities of Judah, Re·ho·boʹam continued to reign over them.

11413.label: 2 Chronicles 10:18
11413.text: Subsequently King Re·ho·boʹam sent Ha·doʹram, who was over those conscripted for forced labor, but the sons of Israel pelted him with stones, so that he died. And King Re·ho·boʹam himself managed to get up into his chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

11414.label: 2 Chronicles 10:19
11414.text: And the Israelites kept up their revolt against the house of David down to this day.

11415.label: 2 Chronicles 11:1
11415.text: When Re·ho·boʹam arrived at Jerusalem, he immediately congregated the house of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand choice men able-bodied for war, to fight against Israel so as to bring the kingdom back to Re·ho·boʹam.

11416.label: 2 Chronicles 11:2
11416.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to She·maiʹah the man of the [true] God, saying:

11417.label: 2 Chronicles 11:3
11417.text: “Say to Re·ho·boʹam the son of Solʹo·mon the king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

11418.label: 2 Chronicles 11:4
11418.text: ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “YOU must not go up and fight against YOUR brothers. Return each one to his house, for it is at my own instance that this thing has been brought about.”’” So they obeyed the word of Jehovah and returned from going against Jer·o·boʹam.

11419.label: 2 Chronicles 11:5
11419.text: And Re·ho·boʹam continued to dwell in Jerusalem and proceeded to build fortified cities in Judah.

11420.label: 2 Chronicles 11:6
11420.text: Thus he rebuilt Bethʹle·hem and Eʹtam and Te·koʹa,

11421.label: 2 Chronicles 11:7
11421.text: and Beth-zur and Soʹco and A·dulʹlam,

11422.label: 2 Chronicles 11:8
11422.text: and Gath and Ma·reʹshah and Ziph,

11423.label: 2 Chronicles 11:9
11423.text: and Ad·o·raʹim and Laʹchish and A·zeʹkah,

11424.label: 2 Chronicles 11:10
11424.text: and Zoʹrah and Aiʹja·lon and Heʹbron, fortified cities, which were in Judah and Benjamin.

11425.label: 2 Chronicles 11:11
11425.text: Further, he reinforced the fortified places and put leaders in them and supplies of food and oil and wine,

11426.label: 2 Chronicles 11:12
11426.text: and in all the different cities large shields and lances; and he went on reinforcing them to a very great degree. And Judah and Benjamin continued his.

11427.label: 2 Chronicles 11:13
11427.text: And the priests and the Levites themselves that were in all Israel took their stand by him out of all their territories.

11428.label: 2 Chronicles 11:14
11428.text: For the Levites left their pasture grounds and their possession and then came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jer·o·boʹam and his sons had discharged them from acting as priests to Jehovah.

11429.label: 2 Chronicles 11:15
11429.text: And he proceeded to put in office for himself priests for the high places and for the goat-shaped demons and for the calves that he had made.

11430.label: 2 Chronicles 11:16
11430.text: And following them from all the tribes of Israel those that were giving their heart to seek Jehovah the God of Israel came themselves to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Jehovah the God of their forefathers.

11431.label: 2 Chronicles 11:17
11431.text: And they kept strengthening the kingship of Judah and confirming Re·ho·boʹam the son of Solʹo·mon for three years, for they walked in the way of David and Solʹo·mon for three years.

11432.label: 2 Chronicles 11:18
11432.text: Then Re·ho·boʹam took as his wife Maʹha·lath the daughter of Jerʹi·moth the son of David, and of Abʹi·ha·il the daughter of E·liʹab the son of Jesʹse.

11433.label: 2 Chronicles 11:19
11433.text: In time she bore him sons, Jeʹush and Shem·a·riʹah and Zaʹham.

11434.label: 2 Chronicles 11:20
11434.text: And after her he took Maʹa·cah the granddaughter of Abʹsa·lom. In time she bore him A·biʹjah and Atʹtai and Ziʹza and She·loʹmith.

11435.label: 2 Chronicles 11:21
11435.text: And Re·ho·boʹam was more in love with Maʹa·cah the granddaughter of Abʹsa·lom than all his other wives and his concubines; for there were eighteen wives that he had taken, also sixty concubines, so that he became father to twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

11436.label: 2 Chronicles 11:22
11436.text: Consequently Re·ho·boʹam put A·biʹjah the son of Maʹa·cah in office as head, as leader among his brothers, for [he thought] of making him king.

11437.label: 2 Chronicles 11:23
11437.text: However, he acted understandingly and distributed some out of all his sons to all the lands of Judah and of Benjamin, to all the fortified cities, and gave them food in abundance and procured a multitude of wives [for them].

11438.label: 2 Chronicles 12:1
11438.text: And it came about that, as soon as the kingship of Re·ho·boʹam was firmly established and as soon as he was strong, he left the law of Jehovah, and also all Israel with him.

11439.label: 2 Chronicles 12:2
11439.text: And it came about in the fifth year of King Re·ho·boʹam that Shiʹshak the king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, (for they had behaved unfaithfully toward Jehovah,)

11440.label: 2 Chronicles 12:3
11440.text: with twelve hundred chariots and with sixty thousand horsemen; and there was no number to the people that came with him out of Egypt—Libʹy·ans, Sukʹki·im and E·thi·oʹpi·ans.

11441.label: 2 Chronicles 12:4
11441.text: And he got to capture the fortified cities that belonged to Judah and finally came as far as Jerusalem.

11442.label: 2 Chronicles 12:5
11442.text: Now as for She·maiʹah the prophet, he came to Re·ho·boʹam and the princes of Judah who had gathered themselves at Jerusalem because of Shiʹshak, and he proceeded to say to them: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘YOU, for your part, have left me, and I, too, for my part, have left YOU to the hand of Shiʹshak.’”

11443.label: 2 Chronicles 12:6
11443.text: At that the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said: “Jehovah is righteous.”

11444.label: 2 Chronicles 12:7
11444.text: And when Jehovah saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of Jehovah came to She·maiʹah, saying: “They have humbled themselves. I shall not bring them to ruin, and in a little while I shall certainly give them an escape, and my rage will not pour forth upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shiʹshak.

11445.label: 2 Chronicles 12:8
11445.text: But they will become servants of his, that they may know the difference between my service and the service of the kingdoms of the lands.”

11446.label: 2 Chronicles 12:9
11446.text: So Shiʹshak the king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took the treasures of the house of Jehovah and the treasures of the king’s house. Everything he took; and so he took the gold shields that Solʹo·mon had made.

11447.label: 2 Chronicles 12:10
11447.text: Consequently King Re·ho·boʹam made in their place copper shields, and he committed them to the control of the chiefs of the runners, the guards of the entrance of the king’s house.

11448.label: 2 Chronicles 12:11
11448.text: And it would occur that as often as the king came to the house of Jehovah, the runners came in and carried them and returned them to the guard chamber of the runners.

11449.label: 2 Chronicles 12:12
11449.text: And because he humbled himself, Jehovah’s anger turned back from him, and he [did] not [think] of bringing them to ruin completely. And, besides, there happened to be good things in Judah.

11450.label: 2 Chronicles 12:13
11450.text: And King Re·ho·boʹam continued to make his position strong in Jerusalem and kept reigning; for Re·ho·boʹam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and for seventeen years he reigned in Jerusalem, the city that Jehovah had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naʹa·mah the Amʹmon·it·ess.

11451.label: 2 Chronicles 12:14
11451.text: But he did what was bad, for he had not firmly established his heart to search for Jehovah.

11452.label: 2 Chronicles 12:15
11452.text: As for Re·ho·boʹam’s affairs, the first and the last, are they not written among the words of She·maiʹah the prophet and of Idʹdo the visionary by genealogical enrollment? And there were wars between Re·ho·boʹam and Jer·o·boʹam all the time.

11453.label: 2 Chronicles 12:16
11453.text: Finally Re·ho·boʹam lay down with his forefathers and was buried in the City of David; and A·biʹjah his son began to reign in place of him.

11454.label: 2 Chronicles 13:1
11454.text: In the eighteenth year of King Jer·o·boʹam it was that A·biʹjah began to reign over Judah.

11455.label: 2 Chronicles 13:2
11455.text: Three years he reigned in Jerusalem, and his mother’s name was Mi·caiʹah the daughter of U·riʹel of Gibʹe·ah. And war itself took place between A·biʹjah and Jer·o·boʹam.

11456.label: 2 Chronicles 13:3
11456.text: So A·biʹjah engaged in the war with a military force of four hundred thousand mighty men of war, chosen men. And Jer·o·boʹam himself drew up in battle formation against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, valiant, mighty men.

11457.label: 2 Chronicles 13:4
11457.text: A·biʹjah now rose up upon Mount Zem·a·raʹim, which is in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, and said: “Hear me, O Jer·o·boʹam and all Israel.

11458.label: 2 Chronicles 13:5
11458.text: Is it not for YOU to know that Jehovah the God of Israel himself gave a kingdom to David over Israel to time indefinite, to him and to his sons, by a covenant of salt?

11459.label: 2 Chronicles 13:6
11459.text: And Jer·o·boʹam the son of Neʹbat, the servant of Solʹo·mon the son of David, proceeded to rise up and rebel against his lord.

11460.label: 2 Chronicles 13:7
11460.text: And idle men, good-for-nothing fellows, kept collecting themselves together by him. Finally they proved superior to Re·ho·boʹam the son of Solʹo·mon, when Re·ho·boʹam himself happened to be young and fainthearted, and he did not hold his own against them.

11461.label: 2 Chronicles 13:8
11461.text: “And now YOU men are thinking of holding YOUR own against the kingdom of Jehovah in the hand of the sons of David, when YOU are a large crowd and there are with YOU the golden calves that Jer·o·boʹam made for YOU as gods.

11462.label: 2 Chronicles 13:9
11462.text: Have YOU not driven out Jehovah’s priests, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and do YOU not keep making priests for yourselves like the peoples of the lands? As for anyone that came and filled his hand with power by means of a young bull and seven rams, he became a priest of what are no gods.

11463.label: 2 Chronicles 13:10
11463.text: As for us, Jehovah is our God, and we have not left him; but priests are ministering to Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and also the Levites in the work.

11464.label: 2 Chronicles 13:11
11464.text: And they are making burnt offerings smoke to Jehovah morning by morning and evening by evening and also perfumed incense; and the layers of bread are upon the table of pure [gold], and there are the golden lampstand and its lamps to light up evening by evening; because we are keeping the obligation to Jehovah our God, but YOU yourselves have left him.

11465.label: 2 Chronicles 13:12
11465.text: And, look! with us there is at the head the [true] God with his priests and the signal trumpets for sounding the battle alarm against YOU. O sons of Israel, do not fight against Jehovah the God of YOUR forefathers, for YOU will not prove successful.”

11466.label: 2 Chronicles 13:13
11466.text: And Jer·o·boʹam, for his part, dispatched an ambush around to come behind them, so that they proved to be in front of Judah and the ambush behind them.

11467.label: 2 Chronicles 13:14
11467.text: When those of Judah turned around, why, there they had the battle in front and behind. And they began to cry out to Jehovah, while the priests were loudly sounding the trumpets.

11468.label: 2 Chronicles 13:15
11468.text: And the men of Judah broke out shouting a war cry. And it came about that, when the men of Judah shouted a war cry, then the [true] God himself defeated Jer·o·boʹam and all Israel before A·biʹjah and Judah.

11469.label: 2 Chronicles 13:16
11469.text: And the sons of Israel took to flight from before Judah, and then God gave them into their hand.

11470.label: 2 Chronicles 13:17
11470.text: And A·biʹjah and his people went striking them down with a vast slaughter; and the slain of Israel kept falling down, five hundred thousand chosen men.

11471.label: 2 Chronicles 13:18
11471.text: Thus the sons of Israel were humbled at that time, but the sons of Judah proved superior because they leaned upon Jehovah the God of their forefathers.

11472.label: 2 Chronicles 13:19
11472.text: And A·biʹjah kept chasing after Jer·o·boʹam and got to capture cities from him, Bethʹel and its dependent towns, and Jeshʹa·nah and its dependent towns, and Eʹphra·in and its dependent towns.

11473.label: 2 Chronicles 13:20
11473.text: And Jer·o·boʹam did not retain any more power in the days of A·biʹjah; but Jehovah dealt him a blow, so that he died.

11474.label: 2 Chronicles 13:21
11474.text: And A·biʹjah continued to strengthen himself. In time he got fourteen wives for himself, and became father to twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

11475.label: 2 Chronicles 13:22
11475.text: And the rest of A·biʹjah’s affairs, even his ways and his words, are written in the exposition of the prophet Idʹdo.

11476.label: 2 Chronicles 14:1
11476.text: Finally A·biʹjah lay down with his forefathers, and they buried him in the City of David; and Aʹsa his son began to reign in place of him. In his days the land had no disturbance for ten years.

11477.label: 2 Chronicles 14:2
11477.text: And Aʹsa proceeded to do what was good and right in the eyes of Jehovah his God.

11478.label: 2 Chronicles 14:3
11478.text: So he removed the foreign altars and the high places and broke up the sacred pillars and cut down the sacred poles.

11479.label: 2 Chronicles 14:4
11479.text: Further, he said to Judah to search for Jehovah the God of their forefathers and to do the law and the commandment.

11480.label: 2 Chronicles 14:5
11480.text: Accordingly he removed from all the cities of Judah the high places and the incense stands; and the kingdom continued without disturbance before him.

11481.label: 2 Chronicles 14:6
11481.text: And he went on to build fortified cities in Judah, for the land had no disturbance; and there was no war against him during these years, for Jehovah gave him rest.

11482.label: 2 Chronicles 14:7
11482.text: So he said to Judah: “Let us build these cities and make walls around and towers, double doors and bars. For us the land is yet available, because we have searched for Jehovah our God. We have searched, and he gives us rest all around.” And they went building and proving successful.

11483.label: 2 Chronicles 14:8
11483.text: And Aʹsa came to have a military force bearing the large shield and lance, three hundred thousand out of Judah. And out of Benjamin those bearing the buckler and bending the bow were two hundred and eighty thousand. All these were valiant, mighty men.

11484.label: 2 Chronicles 14:9
11484.text: Later Zeʹrah the E·thi·oʹpi·an went out against them with a military force of a million men and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Ma·reʹshah.

11485.label: 2 Chronicles 14:10
11485.text: Then Aʹsa went out against him and they drew up in battle formation in the valley of Zephʹa·thah at Ma·reʹshah.

11486.label: 2 Chronicles 14:11
11486.text: And Aʹsa began to call to Jehovah his God and say: “O Jehovah, as to helping, it does not matter with you whether there are many or [those with] no power. Help us, O Jehovah our God, for upon you we do lean, and in your name we have come against this crowd. O Jehovah, you are our God. Do not let mortal man retain strength against you.”

11487.label: 2 Chronicles 14:12
11487.text: At that Jehovah defeated the E·thi·oʹpi·ans before Aʹsa and before Judah, and the E·thi·oʹpi·ans took to flight.

11488.label: 2 Chronicles 14:13
11488.text: And Aʹsa and the people that were with him kept pursuing them as far as Geʹrar, and those of the E·thi·oʹpi·ans continued falling down till there was no one alive of them; for they were broken to pieces before Jehovah and before his camp. Afterward they carried off a very great deal of spoil.

11489.label: 2 Chronicles 14:14
11489.text: Further, they struck all the cities round about Geʹrar, for the dread of Jehovah had come to be upon them; and they went plundering all the cities, for there happened to be much to plunder in them.

11490.label: 2 Chronicles 14:15
11490.text: And even the tents with livestock they struck so that they took captive flocks in great number and camels, after which they returned to Jerusalem.

11491.label: 2 Chronicles 15:1
11491.text: Now for Az·a·riʹah the son of Oʹded, the spirit of God came to be upon him.

11492.label: 2 Chronicles 15:2
11492.text: Consequently he went out before Aʹsa and said to him: “Hear me, O Aʹsa and all Judah and Benjamin! Jehovah is with YOU as long as YOU prove to be with him; and if YOU search for him, he will let himself be found by YOU, but if YOU leave him he will leave YOU.

11493.label: 2 Chronicles 15:3
11493.text: And many were the days that Israel had been without a true God and without a priest teaching and without Law.

11494.label: 2 Chronicles 15:4
11494.text: But when in their distress they returned to Jehovah the God of Israel and looked for him, then he let himself be found by them.

11495.label: 2 Chronicles 15:5
11495.text: And in those times there was no peace for one going out or for one coming in, because there were many disorders among all the inhabitants of the lands.

11496.label: 2 Chronicles 15:6
11496.text: And they were crushed to pieces, nation against nation and city against city, because God himself kept them in disorder with every sort of distress.

11497.label: 2 Chronicles 15:7
11497.text: And YOU, be courageous and do not let YOUR hands drop down, because there exists a reward for YOUR activity.”

11498.label: 2 Chronicles 15:8
11498.text: And as soon as Aʹsa heard these words and the prophecy of Oʹded the prophet, he took courage and proceeded to cause the disgusting things to vanish from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities that he had captured from the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, and to renew Jehovah’s altar that was before the porch of Jehovah.

11499.label: 2 Chronicles 15:9
11499.text: And he began to collect together all Judah and Benjamin and the alien residents with them from Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh and Simʹe·on, for they had deserted to him from Israel in great number when they saw that Jehovah his God was with him.

11500.label: 2 Chronicles 15:10
11500.text: So they were collected together at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Aʹsa’s reign.

11501.label: 2 Chronicles 15:11
11501.text: Then they sacrificed to Jehovah on that day from the spoil they had brought, seven hundred cattle and seven thousand sheep.

11502.label: 2 Chronicles 15:12
11502.text: Furthermore, they entered into a covenant to search for Jehovah the God of their forefathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

11503.label: 2 Chronicles 15:13
11503.text: that anyone that would not search for Jehovah the God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

11504.label: 2 Chronicles 15:14
11504.text: So they swore to Jehovah with a loud voice and with joyful shouting and with the trumpets and with horns.

11505.label: 2 Chronicles 15:15
11505.text: And all Judah gave way to rejoicing over the thing sworn; for it was with all their heart that they had sworn and with full pleasure on their part that they had looked for him, so that he let himself be found by them; and Jehovah continued to give them rest all around.

11506.label: 2 Chronicles 15:16
11506.text: As for even Maʹa·cah [his] grandmother, Aʹsa the king himself removed her from [being] lady, because she had made a horrible idol for the sacred pole; and then Aʹsa cut down her horrible idol and pulverized it and burned it in the torrent valley of Kidʹron.

11507.label: 2 Chronicles 15:17
11507.text: And the high places themselves did not disappear from Israel. Only Aʹsa’s heart itself proved to be complete all his days.

11508.label: 2 Chronicles 15:18
11508.text: And he proceeded to bring the things made holy by his father and the things made holy by himself into the house of the [true] God, silver and gold and utensils.

11509.label: 2 Chronicles 15:19
11509.text: As for war, it did not occur down to the thirty-fifth year of Aʹsa’s reign.

11510.label: 2 Chronicles 16:1
11510.text: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Aʹsa, Baʹa·sha the king of Israel came up against Judah and began to build Raʹmah, so as not to allow anyone to go out or come in to Aʹsa the king of Judah.

11511.label: 2 Chronicles 16:2
11511.text: Aʹsa now brought out silver and gold from the treasures of Jehovah’s house and the king’s house and sent to Ben-haʹdad the king of Syria, who was dwelling at Damascus, saying:

11512.label: 2 Chronicles 16:3
11512.text: “There is a covenant between me and you and between my father and your father. Here I do send you silver and gold. Go, break your covenant with Baʹa·sha the king of Israel, that he may withdraw from me.”

11513.label: 2 Chronicles 16:4
11513.text: So Ben-haʹdad listened to King Aʹsa and sent the chiefs of the military forces that were his against the cities of Israel, so that they struck Iʹjon and Dan and Aʹbel-maʹim and all the storage places of the cities of Naphʹta·li.

11514.label: 2 Chronicles 16:5
11514.text: And it came about that as soon as Baʹa·sha heard of it, he immediately quit building Raʹmah and stopped his work.

11515.label: 2 Chronicles 16:6
11515.text: As for Aʹsa the king, he took all Judah, and they proceeded to carry away the stones of Raʹmah and its timbers with which Baʹa·sha had built, and he began to build with them Geʹba and Mizʹpah.

11516.label: 2 Chronicles 16:7
11516.text: And at that time Ha·naʹni the seer came to Aʹsa the king of Judah and then said to him: “Because you leaned upon the king of Syria and did not lean upon Jehovah your God, for that reason the military force of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

11517.label: 2 Chronicles 16:8
11517.text: Did not the E·thi·oʹpi·ans and the Libʹy·ans themselves happen to be a very great military force in multitude, in chariots and in horsemen; and because of your leaning upon Jehovah did he not give them into your hand?

11518.label: 2 Chronicles 16:9
11518.text: For, as regards Jehovah, his eyes are roving about through all the earth to show his strength in behalf of those whose heart is complete toward him. You have acted foolishly respecting this, for from now on there will exist wars against you.”

11519.label: 2 Chronicles 16:10
11519.text: However, Aʹsa became offended at the seer and put him in the house of the stocks, because he was in a rage at him over this. And Aʹsa began to crush some others of the people at that same time.

11520.label: 2 Chronicles 16:11
11520.text: And, look! the affairs of Aʹsa, the first and the last, there they are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and of Israel.

11521.label: 2 Chronicles 16:12
11521.text: And Aʹsa in the thirty-ninth year of his reign developed an ailment in his feet until he was very sick; and even in his sickness he searched not for Jehovah but for the healers.

11522.label: 2 Chronicles 16:13
11522.text: Finally Aʹsa lay down with his forefathers and died in the forty-first year of his reigning.

11523.label: 2 Chronicles 16:14
11523.text: So they buried him in his grand burial place that he had excavated for himself in the City of David; and they laid him in the bed that had been filled with balsam oil and different sorts of ointment mixed in an ointment of special make. Further, they made an extraordinarily great funeral burning for him.

11524.label: 2 Chronicles 17:1
11524.text: And Je·hoshʹa·phat his son began to reign in place of him and to make his position strong over Israel.

11525.label: 2 Chronicles 17:2
11525.text: And he proceeded to put military forces in all the fortified cities of Judah and to put garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Eʹphra·im that Aʹsa his father had captured.

11526.label: 2 Chronicles 17:3
11526.text: And Jehovah continued with Je·hoshʹa·phat, because he walked in the former ways of David his forefather and did not search for the Baʹals.

11527.label: 2 Chronicles 17:4
11527.text: For it was for the God of his father that he searched and in his commandment he walked, and not according to the doing of Israel.

11528.label: 2 Chronicles 17:5
11528.text: And Jehovah kept the kingdom firmly established in his hand; and all Judah continued to give presents to Je·hoshʹa·phat, and he came to have riches and glory in abundance.

11529.label: 2 Chronicles 17:6
11529.text: And his heart became bold in the ways of Jehovah, and he even removed the high places and the sacred poles from Judah.

11530.label: 2 Chronicles 17:7
11530.text: And in the third year of his reigning he sent for his princes, namely, Ben-haʹil and O·ba·diʹah and Zech·a·riʹah and Ne·thanʹel and Mi·caiʹah, to teach in the cities of Judah,

11531.label: 2 Chronicles 17:8
11531.text: and with them the Levites, She·maiʹah and Neth·a·niʹah and Zeb·a·diʹah and Asʹa·hel and She·mirʹa·moth and Je·honʹa·than and Ad·o·niʹjah and To·biʹjah and Tob-ad·o·niʹjah the Levites, and with them E·lishʹa·ma and Je·hoʹram the priests.

11532.label: 2 Chronicles 17:9
11532.text: And they began teaching in Judah, and with them there was the book of Jehovah’s law; and they kept going around through all the cities of Judah and teaching among the people.

11533.label: 2 Chronicles 17:10
11533.text: And the dread of Jehovah came to be upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were all around Judah, and they did not fight against Je·hoshʹa·phat.

11534.label: 2 Chronicles 17:11
11534.text: And from the Phi·lisʹtines they were bringing to Je·hoshʹa·phat presents and money as tribute. The Arabs also were bringing to him flocks, seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred he-goats.

11535.label: 2 Chronicles 17:12
11535.text: And Je·hoshʹa·phat continued advancing and growing great to a superior degree; and he went on building fortified places and storage cities in Judah.

11536.label: 2 Chronicles 17:13
11536.text: And there were many interests that became his in the cities of Judah; and warriors, valiant, mighty men, were in Jerusalem.

11537.label: 2 Chronicles 17:14
11537.text: And these were their offices by the house of their forefathers: Of Judah the chiefs of thousands, Adʹnah the chief, and with him there were three hundred thousand valiant, mighty men.

11538.label: 2 Chronicles 17:15
11538.text: And under his control there was Je·ho·haʹnan the chief, and with him there were two hundred and eighty thousand.

11539.label: 2 Chronicles 17:16
11539.text: And under his control there was Am·a·siʹah the son of Zichʹri the volunteer for Jehovah, and with him there were two hundred thousand valiant, mighty men.

11540.label: 2 Chronicles 17:17
11540.text: And out of Benjamin there was the valiant, mighty man E·liʹa·da, and with him there were two hundred thousand men equipped with the bow and shield.

11541.label: 2 Chronicles 17:18
11541.text: And under his control there was Je·hozʹa·bad, and with him there were a hundred and eighty thousand men outfitted for the army.

11542.label: 2 Chronicles 17:19
11542.text: These were the ones ministering to the king apart from those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

11543.label: 2 Chronicles 18:1
11543.text: And Je·hoshʹa·phat came to have riches and glory in abundance; but he formed a marriage alliance with Aʹhab.

11544.label: 2 Chronicles 18:2
11544.text: So years later he went down to Aʹhab at Sa·marʹi·a; and Aʹhab proceeded to sacrifice sheep and cattle in abundance for him and for the people that were with him. And he began to allure him to go up against Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad.

11545.label: 2 Chronicles 18:3
11545.text: And Aʹhab the king of Israel went on to say to Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah: “Will you go with me to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad?” At this he said to him: “I am the same as you are, and my people are like your people and with you in the war.”

11546.label: 2 Chronicles 18:4
11546.text: However, Je·hoshʹa·phat said to the king of Israel: “Please, inquire first of all for the word of Jehovah.”

11547.label: 2 Chronicles 18:5
11547.text: So the king of Israel collected the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them: “Shall we go against Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad in war, or shall I refrain?” And they began to say: “Go up, and the [true] God will give [it] into the king’s hand.”

11548.label: 2 Chronicles 18:6
11548.text: But Je·hoshʹa·phat said: “Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah still? Then let us inquire through him.”

11549.label: 2 Chronicles 18:7
11549.text: At that the king of Israel said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “There is still one man through whom to inquire of Jehovah, but I myself certainly hate him, for he is prophesying concerning me, not for good, but, all his days, for bad. He is Mi·caiʹah the son of Imʹlah.” However, Je·hoshʹa·phat said: “Do not let the king say a thing like that.”

11550.label: 2 Chronicles 18:8
11550.text: Accordingly the king of Israel called a court official and said: “Bring Mi·caiʹah the son of Imʹlah quickly.”

11551.label: 2 Chronicles 18:9
11551.text: Now the king of Israel and Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah were sitting each one on his throne, clothed in garments, and were sitting in the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Sa·marʹi·a; and all the prophets were acting as prophets before them.

11552.label: 2 Chronicles 18:10
11552.text: Then Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Che·naʹa·nah made for himself horns of iron and said: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘With these you will push the Syrians until you exterminate them.’”

11553.label: 2 Chronicles 18:11
11553.text: And all the other prophets were prophesying the same as that, saying: “Go up to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad and prove successful, and Jehovah will certainly give [it] into the king’s hand.”

11554.label: 2 Chronicles 18:12
