11554.text: And the messenger that went to call Mi·caiʹah spoke to him, saying: “Look! The words of the prophets are unanimously of good to the king; and let your word, please, become like one of them and you must speak good.”

11555.label: 2 Chronicles 18:13
11555.text: But Mi·caiʹah said: “As Jehovah is living, what my God will say, that is what I shall speak.”

11556.label: 2 Chronicles 18:14
11556.text: Then he came in to the king, and the king proceeded to say to him: “Mi·caiʹah, shall we go to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad in war, or shall I refrain?” At once he said: “Go up and prove successful; and they will be given into YOUR hand.”

11557.label: 2 Chronicles 18:15
11557.text: At that the king said to him: “For how many times am I putting you under oath that you should not speak to me anything but truth in the name of Jehovah?”

11558.label: 2 Chronicles 18:16
11558.text: So he said: “I certainly see all the Israelites scattered upon the mountains, like sheep that have no shepherd. And Jehovah went on to say: ‘These have no masters. Let them go back each one to his house in peace.’”

11559.label: 2 Chronicles 18:17
11559.text: Then the king of Israel said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “Did I not say to you, ‘He will prophesy concerning me, not good things, but bad’?”

11560.label: 2 Chronicles 18:18
11560.text: And he went on to say: “Therefore HEAR the word of Jehovah: I certainly see Jehovah sitting upon his throne and all the army of the heavens standing at his right and his left.

11561.label: 2 Chronicles 18:19
11561.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say, ‘Who will fool Aʹhab the king of Israel that he may go up and fall at Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad?’ And there was talk, this one saying something like this, and that one saying something like that.

11562.label: 2 Chronicles 18:20
11562.text: Finally a spirit came out and stood before Jehovah and said, ‘I myself shall fool him.’ At that Jehovah said to him, ‘By what means?’

11563.label: 2 Chronicles 18:21
11563.text: To this he said, ‘I shall go forth and certainly become a deceptive spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ So he said, ‘You will fool him, and, what is more, you will come off the winner. Go out and do that way.’

11564.label: 2 Chronicles 18:22
11564.text: And now here Jehovah has put a deceptive spirit in the mouth of these prophets of yours; but Jehovah himself has spoken calamity concerning you.”

11565.label: 2 Chronicles 18:23
11565.text: Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Che·naʹa·nah now approached and struck Mi·caiʹah on the cheek and said: “In just which way did the spirit of Jehovah pass along from me to speak with you?”

11566.label: 2 Chronicles 18:24
11566.text: At that Mi·caiʹah said: “Look! You are seeing [which way] on that day when you will enter the innermost chamber to hide yourself.”

11567.label: 2 Chronicles 18:25
11567.text: Then the king of Israel said: “TAKE Mi·caiʹah and turn him back to Aʹmon the chief of the city and to Joʹash the king’s son.

11568.label: 2 Chronicles 18:26
11568.text: And YOU men must say, ‘This is what the king has said: “PUT this fellow in the house of detention and feed him with a reduced allowance of bread and a reduced allowance of water until I return in peace.”’”

11569.label: 2 Chronicles 18:27
11569.text: Upon that Mi·caiʹah said: “If you return at all in peace, Jehovah has not spoken with me.” And he added: “Hear, all YOU peoples.”

11570.label: 2 Chronicles 18:28
11570.text: And the king of Israel and Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah proceeded to go up to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad.

11571.label: 2 Chronicles 18:29
11571.text: The king of Israel now said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “There will be a disguising and entering into the battle [for me], but you, for your part, put on your garments.” Accordingly the king of Israel disguised himself, after which they entered into the battle.

11572.label: 2 Chronicles 18:30
11572.text: As for the king of Syria, he had commanded the chiefs of the chariots that were his, saying: “YOU must fight, neither with the small nor with the great, but with the king of Israel alone.”

11573.label: 2 Chronicles 18:31
11573.text: And it came about that, as soon as the chiefs of the chariots saw Je·hoshʹa·phat, they, for their part, said to themselves: “It is the king of Israel.” So they turned around against him to fight; and Je·hoshʹa·phat began to cry for aid, and Jehovah himself helped him, and God at once allured them away from him.

11574.label: 2 Chronicles 18:32
11574.text: And it came about that as soon as the chiefs of the chariots saw that it did not prove to be the king of Israel, they immediately came back from following him.

11575.label: 2 Chronicles 18:33
11575.text: And there was a man that bent the bow in his innocence, but he got to strike the king of Israel between the appendages and the coat of mail, so that he said to the charioteer: “Turn your hand around, and you must take me out from the camp, because I have been badly wounded.”

11576.label: 2 Chronicles 18:34
11576.text: And the battle kept rising in intensity on that day, and the king of Israel himself had to be kept in a standing position in the chariot facing the Syrians until the evening; and gradually he died at the time of the setting of the sun.

11577.label: 2 Chronicles 19:1
11577.text: Then Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah returned in peace to his own house at Jerusalem.

11578.label: 2 Chronicles 19:2
11578.text: Jeʹhu the son of Ha·naʹni the visionary now went out before him and said to King Je·hoshʹa·phat: “Is it to the wicked that help is to be given, and is it for those hating Jehovah that you should have love? And for this there is indignation against you from the person of Jehovah.

11579.label: 2 Chronicles 19:3
11579.text: Nevertheless, there are good things that have been found with you, because you have cleared out the sacred poles from the land and you have prepared your heart to search for the [true] God.”

11580.label: 2 Chronicles 19:4
11580.text: And Je·hoshʹa·phat continued dwelling in Jerusalem; and he began to go out again among the people from Beʹer-sheʹba to the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, that he might bring them back to Jehovah the God of their forefathers.

11581.label: 2 Chronicles 19:5
11581.text: And he proceeded to station judges throughout the land in all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city.

11582.label: 2 Chronicles 19:6
11582.text: And he went on to say to the judges: “See what YOU are doing, because it is not for man that YOU judge but it is for Jehovah; and he is with YOU in the matter of judgment.

11583.label: 2 Chronicles 19:7
11583.text: And now let the dread of Jehovah come to be upon YOU. Be careful and act, for with Jehovah our God there is no unrighteousness or partiality or taking of a bribe.”

11584.label: 2 Chronicles 19:8
11584.text: And in Jerusalem also Je·hoshʹa·phat stationed some of the Levites and the priests and some of the heads of the paternal houses of Israel for the judgment of Jehovah and for the legal cases of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

11585.label: 2 Chronicles 19:9
11585.text: Further, he laid a command upon them, saying: “This is how YOU should do in the fear of Jehovah with faithfulness and with a complete heart.

11586.label: 2 Chronicles 19:10
11586.text: As for every legal case that will come to YOU of YOUR brothers who are dwelling in their cities, involving the shedding of blood, involving law and commandment and regulations and judicial decisions, YOU must warn them that they may not do wrong against Jehovah and indignation may not have to take place against YOU and against YOUR brothers. This is how YOU should do that YOU may not incur guilt.

11587.label: 2 Chronicles 19:11
11587.text: And here is Am·a·riʹah the chief priest over YOU for every matter of Jehovah; and Zeb·a·diʹah the son of Ishʹma·el the leader of the house of Judah for every matter of the king; and as officers the Levites are available for YOU. Be strong and act, and let Jehovah prove to be with what is good.”

11588.label: 2 Chronicles 20:1
11588.text: And it came about afterward that the sons of Moʹab and the sons of Amʹmon and with them some of the Amʹmon·im came against Je·hoshʹa·phat in war.

11589.label: 2 Chronicles 20:2
11589.text: So people came and told Je·hoshʹa·phat, saying: “There has come against you a large crowd from the region of the sea, from Eʹdom; and there they are in Hazʹa·zon-taʹmar, that is to say, En-geʹdi.”

11590.label: 2 Chronicles 20:3
11590.text: At that Je·hoshʹa·phat became afraid and set his face to search for Jehovah. So he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.

11591.label: 2 Chronicles 20:4
11591.text: Eventually those of Judah were collected together to inquire of Jehovah. Even from all the cities of Judah they came to consult Jehovah.

11592.label: 2 Chronicles 20:5
11592.text: Then Je·hoshʹa·phat stood up in the congregation of Judah and of Jerusalem in the house of Jehovah before the new courtyard,

11593.label: 2 Chronicles 20:6
11593.text: and he proceeded to say: “O Jehovah the God of our forefathers, are you not God in the heavens, and are you not dominating over all the kingdoms of the nations, and are there not in your hand power and mightiness, with no one to hold his ground against you?

11594.label: 2 Chronicles 20:7
11594.text: Did not you yourself, O God of ours, drive away the inhabitants of this land from before your people Israel and then give it to the seed of Abraham, your lover, to time indefinite?

11595.label: 2 Chronicles 20:8
11595.text: And they took up dwelling in it, and they proceeded to build in it for you a sanctuary for your name, saying,

11596.label: 2 Chronicles 20:9
11596.text: ‘If there should come upon us calamity, sword, adverse judgment, or pestilence or famine, let us stand before this house and before you (for your name is in this house), that we may call to you for aid out of our distress, and may you hear and save.’

11597.label: 2 Chronicles 20:10
11597.text: And now here the sons of Amʹmon, and Moʹab and the mountainous region of Seʹir, whom you did not allow Israel to invade when they were coming out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them and did not annihilate them,

11598.label: 2 Chronicles 20:11
11598.text: yes, here they are rewarding us by coming in to drive us out from your possession that you caused us to possess.

11599.label: 2 Chronicles 20:12
11599.text: O our God, will you not execute judgment upon them? For in us there is no power before this large crowd that is coming against us; and we ourselves do not know what we ought to do, but our eyes are toward you.”

11600.label: 2 Chronicles 20:13
11600.text: All the while all those of Judah were standing before Jehovah, even their little ones, their wives and their sons.

11601.label: 2 Chronicles 20:14
11601.text: Now as for Ja·ha·ziʹel the son of Zech·a·riʹah the son of Be·naiʹah the son of Je·iʹel the son of Mat·ta·niʹah the Levite of the sons of Aʹsaph, the spirit of Jehovah came to be upon him in the middle of the congregation.

11602.label: 2 Chronicles 20:15
11602.text: Consequently he said: “Pay attention, all Judah and YOU inhabitants of Jerusalem and King Je·hoshʹa·phat! Here is what Jehovah has said to YOU, ‘Do not YOU be afraid or be terrified because of this large crowd; for the battle is not YOURS, but God’s.

11603.label: 2 Chronicles 20:16
11603.text: Tomorrow go down against them. There they are coming up by the pass of Ziz; and YOU will be certain to find them at the end of the torrent valley in front of the wilderness of Je·ruʹel.

11604.label: 2 Chronicles 20:17
11604.text: YOU will not need to fight in this instance. Take YOUR position, stand still and see the salvation of Jehovah in YOUR behalf. O Judah and Jerusalem, do not be afraid or be terrified. Tomorrow go out against them, and Jehovah will be with YOU.’”

11605.label: 2 Chronicles 20:18
11605.text: At once Je·hoshʹa·phat bowed low with his face to the earth, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem themselves fell down before Jehovah to do obeisance to Jehovah.

11606.label: 2 Chronicles 20:19
11606.text: Then the Levites of the sons of the Koʹhath·ites and of the sons of the Koʹrah·ites rose up to praise Jehovah the God of Israel with an extraordinarily loud voice.

11607.label: 2 Chronicles 20:20
11607.text: And they proceeded to rise early in the morning and go out to the wilderness of Te·koʹa. And as they went out, Je·hoshʹa·phat stood up and then said: “Hear me, O Judah and YOU inhabitants of Jerusalem! Put faith in Jehovah YOUR God that YOU may prove yourselves of long duration. Put faith in his prophets and so prove successful.”

11608.label: 2 Chronicles 20:21
11608.text: Further, he took counsel with the people and stationed singers to Jehovah and those offering praise in holy adornment as they went out ahead of the armed men, and saying: “GIVE praise to Jehovah, for to time indefinite is his loving-kindness.”

11609.label: 2 Chronicles 20:22
11609.text: And at the time that they started off with the joyful cry and praise, Jehovah set men in ambush against the sons of Amʹmon, Moʹab and the mountainous region of Seʹir who were coming into Judah, and they went smiting one another.

11610.label: 2 Chronicles 20:23
11610.text: And the sons of Amʹmon and Moʹab proceeded to stand up against the inhabitants of the mountainous region of Seʹir to devote them to destruction and annihilate them; and as soon as they finished with the inhabitants of Seʹir, they helped each one to bring his own fellow to ruin.

11611.label: 2 Chronicles 20:24
11611.text: But as for Judah, it came to the watchtower of the wilderness. When they turned their faces toward the crowd, why, there they were, their carcasses fallen to the earth without anyone escaping.

11612.label: 2 Chronicles 20:25
11612.text: So Je·hoshʹa·phat and his people came to plunder the spoil on them, and they got to find among them in abundance both goods and clothing and desirable articles; and they went stripping them off for themselves until they could carry no more. And it came to be three days that they were plundering the spoil, for it was abundant.

11613.label: 2 Chronicles 20:26
11613.text: And on the fourth day they congregated together at the low plain of Berʹa·cah, for there they blessed Jehovah. That is why they called the name of that place Low Plain of Berʹa·cah —until today.

11614.label: 2 Chronicles 20:27
11614.text: Then all the men of Judah and Jerusalem returned, with Je·hoshʹa·phat at their head, to return to Jerusalem with rejoicing, for Jehovah had made them rejoice over their enemies.

11615.label: 2 Chronicles 20:28
11615.text: So they came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments and with harps and with trumpets to the house of Jehovah.

11616.label: 2 Chronicles 20:29
11616.text: And the dread of God came to be upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that Jehovah had fought against the enemies of Israel.

11617.label: 2 Chronicles 20:30
11617.text: Thus the royal realm of Je·hoshʹa·phat had no disturbance, and his God continued to give him rest all around.

11618.label: 2 Chronicles 20:31
11618.text: And Je·hoshʹa·phat went on reigning over Judah. Thirty-five years old he was when he began to reign, and for twenty-five years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was A·zuʹbah the daughter of Shilʹhi.

11619.label: 2 Chronicles 20:32
11619.text: And he kept walking in the way of his father Aʹsa, and he did not turn aside from it, by doing what was right in Jehovah’s eyes.

11620.label: 2 Chronicles 20:33
11620.text: Only the high places themselves did not disappear; and the people themselves had not yet prepared their heart for the God of their forefathers.

11621.label: 2 Chronicles 20:34
11621.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Je·hoshʹa·phat, the first and the last, there they are written among the words of Jeʹhu the son of Ha·naʹni, which were inserted in the Book of the Kings of Israel.

11622.label: 2 Chronicles 20:35
11622.text: And after this Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah had partnership with A·ha·ziʹah the king of Israel, who acted wickedly.

11623.label: 2 Chronicles 20:36
11623.text: So he made him a partner with himself in making ships to go to Tarʹshish and they made ships in Eʹzi·on-geʹber.

11624.label: 2 Chronicles 20:37
11624.text: However, E·li·eʹzer the son of Dod·avʹa·hu of Ma·reʹsha spoke prophetically against Je·hoshʹa·phat, saying: “Inasmuch as you have had partnership with A·ha·ziʹah, Jehovah will certainly break down your works.” Accordingly the ships were wrecked, and they did not retain strength to go to Tarʹshish.

11625.label: 2 Chronicles 21:1
11625.text: Finally Je·hoshʹa·phat lay down with his forefathers and was buried with his forefathers in the City of David; and Je·hoʹram his son began to reign in place of him.

11626.label: 2 Chronicles 21:2
11626.text: And he had brothers, Je·hoshʹa·phat’s sons, Az·a·riʹah and Je·hiʹel and Zech·a·riʹah and Az·a·riʹah and Miʹcha·el and Sheph·a·tiʹah, all these being the sons of Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Israel.

11627.label: 2 Chronicles 21:3
11627.text: Consequently their father gave them many gifts in silver and in gold and in choice things along with fortified cities in Judah; but the kingdom he gave to Je·hoʹram, for he was the firstborn.

11628.label: 2 Chronicles 21:4
11628.text: When Je·hoʹram rose up over the kingdom of his father he proceeded to make his position strong, and so he killed all his brothers with the sword and also some of the princes of Israel.

11629.label: 2 Chronicles 21:5
11629.text: Thirty-two years old was Je·hoʹram when he began to reign, and for eight years he reigned in Jerusalem.

11630.label: 2 Chronicles 21:6
11630.text: And he went on walking in the way of the kings of Israel, just as those of the house of Aʹhab had done; for Aʹhab’s own daughter had become his wife, and he continued to do what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes.

11631.label: 2 Chronicles 21:7
11631.text: And Jehovah did not want to bring the house of David to ruin, for the sake of the covenant that he had concluded with David, and just as he had said he would give him and his sons a lamp always.

11632.label: 2 Chronicles 21:8
11632.text: In his days Eʹdom revolted from under the hand of Judah and then made a king to reign over them.

11633.label: 2 Chronicles 21:9
11633.text: So Je·hoʹram together with his chiefs passed over and also all the chariots with him. And it came about that he rose up by night and went striking down the Eʹdom·ites that were surrounding him and also the chiefs of the chariots.

11634.label: 2 Chronicles 21:10
11634.text: But Eʹdom kept up its revolt from under the hand of Judah down to this day. It was then that Libʹnah began to revolt at the same time from under his hand, because he had left Jehovah the God of his forefathers.

11635.label: 2 Chronicles 21:11
11635.text: He himself also had made high places on the mountains of Judah, that he might cause the inhabitants of Jerusalem to have immoral intercourse, and that he might drive Judah away.

11636.label: 2 Chronicles 21:12
11636.text: Eventually there came a writing to him from E·liʹjah the prophet, saying: “This is what Jehovah the God of David your forefather has said, ‘Due to the fact that you have not walked in the ways of Je·hoshʹa·phat your father or in the ways of Aʹsa the king of Judah,

11637.label: 2 Chronicles 21:13
11637.text: but you walk in the way of the kings of Israel and cause Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to have immoral intercourse the same way that the house of Aʹhab caused the having of immoral intercourse, and even your own brothers, the household of your father, who were better than you, you have killed;

11638.label: 2 Chronicles 21:14
11638.text: look! Jehovah is dealing a great blow to your people and to your sons and to your wives and to all your goods.

11639.label: 2 Chronicles 21:15
11639.text: And you will be with many sicknesses, with a malady of your intestines, until your intestines have come out because of the sickness day by day.’”

11640.label: 2 Chronicles 21:16
11640.text: Accordingly Jehovah aroused against Je·hoʹram the spirit of the Phi·lisʹtines and the Arabs that were by the side of the E·thi·oʹpi·ans.

11641.label: 2 Chronicles 21:17
11641.text: So they came up into Judah and forced it open and took captive all the goods that were to be found in the king’s house and also his sons and his wives, and there was not left to him a son but Je·hoʹa·haz, his youngest son.

11642.label: 2 Chronicles 21:18
11642.text: And after all this Jehovah plagued him in his intestines with a sickness for which there was no healing.

11643.label: 2 Chronicles 21:19
11643.text: And it came about that in the days to come, even when the term of two full years had expired, his intestines came out during his sickness, and he gradually died in his bad maladies; and his people did not make a burning for him like the burning for his forefathers.

11644.label: 2 Chronicles 21:20
11644.text: Thirty-two years old he happened to be when he began to reign, and for eight years he reigned in Jerusalem. Finally he went away without being desired. So they buried him in the City of David, but not in the burial places of the kings.

11645.label: 2 Chronicles 22:1
11645.text: Then the inhabitants of Jerusalem made A·ha·ziʹah his youngest son king in place of him, (for the marauder band that came with the Arabs to the camp had killed all the older ones,) and A·ha·ziʹah the son of Je·hoʹram began to reign as king of Judah.

11646.label: 2 Chronicles 22:2
11646.text: Twenty-two years old was A·ha·ziʹah when he began to reign, and for one year he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Ath·a·liʹah the granddaughter of Omʹri.

11647.label: 2 Chronicles 22:3
11647.text: He himself also walked in the ways of the house of Aʹhab, for his mother herself became his counselor in doing wickedly.

11648.label: 2 Chronicles 22:4
11648.text: And he went on doing what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes, the same as the house of Aʹhab, for they themselves became counselors to him after the death of his father, to his ruination.

11649.label: 2 Chronicles 22:5
11649.text: It was also in their counsel that he walked, so that he went with Je·hoʹram the son of Aʹhab the king of Israel to the war against Hazʹa·el the king of Syria at Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad, at which the shooters got to strike Je·hoʹram.

11650.label: 2 Chronicles 22:6
11650.text: Hence he returned to get healed at Jezʹre·el from the wounds that they had inflicted upon him at Raʹmah when he fought Hazʹa·el the king of Syria. As for Az·a·riʹah the son of Je·hoʹram the king of Judah, he went down to see Je·hoʹram the son of Aʹhab in Jezʹre·el, for he was sick.

11651.label: 2 Chronicles 22:7
11651.text: But it was from God that the downfall of A·ha·ziʹah occurred by [his] coming to Je·hoʹram; and when he came, he went out with Je·hoʹram to Jeʹhu the grandson of Nimʹshi, whom Jehovah had anointed to cut off the house of Aʹhab.

11652.label: 2 Chronicles 22:8
11652.text: And it came about that as soon as Jeʹhu had entered into controversy with the house of Aʹhab, he got to find the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of A·ha·ziʹah, ministers of A·ha·ziʹah, and he proceeded to kill them.

11653.label: 2 Chronicles 22:9
11653.text: Then he went looking for A·ha·ziʹah, and they finally captured him, as he was hiding in Sa·marʹi·a, and brought him to Jeʹhu. Then they put him to death and buried him, for they said: “He is the grandson of Je·hoshʹa·phat, who searched for Jehovah with all his heart.” And there was no one of the house of A·ha·ziʹah to retain power for the kingdom.

11654.label: 2 Chronicles 22:10
11654.text: As regards Ath·a·liʹah the mother of A·ha·ziʹah, she saw that her son had died. So she rose up and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

11655.label: 2 Chronicles 22:11
11655.text: However, Je·ho·shabʹe·ath the daughter of the king took Je·hoʹash the son of A·ha·ziʹah and stole him away from among the sons of the king that were to be put to death, and put him and his nursing woman in the inner room for the couches. And Je·ho·shabʹe·ath the daughter of King Je·hoʹram, the wife of Je·hoiʹa·da the priest, (for she herself happened to be the sister of A·ha·ziʹah,) kept him concealed because of Ath·a·liʹah, and she did not put him to death.

11656.label: 2 Chronicles 22:12
11656.text: And he continued with them in the house of the [true] God hidden for six years, while Ath·a·liʹah was ruling as queen over the land.

11657.label: 2 Chronicles 23:1
11657.text: And in the seventh year Je·hoiʹa·da showed himself courageous and proceeded to take the chiefs of hundreds, namely, Az·a·riʹah the son of Je·roʹham, and Ishʹma·el the son of Je·ho·haʹnan and Az·a·riʹah the son of Oʹbed and Ma·a·seiʹah the son of A·daiʹah and E·li·shaʹphat the son of Zichʹri, with him into the covenant.

11658.label: 2 Chronicles 23:2
11658.text: Afterward they went around throughout Judah and collected together the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the paternal houses of Israel. So they came to Jerusalem.

11659.label: 2 Chronicles 23:3
11659.text: Then all the congregation concluded a covenant with the king in the house of the [true] God, after which he said to them: “Look! The son of the king himself will reign, just as Jehovah promised concerning the sons of David.

11660.label: 2 Chronicles 23:4
11660.text: This is the thing that YOU will do: one third of YOU who are coming in on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, will be for doorkeepers;

11661.label: 2 Chronicles 23:5
11661.text: and one third will be at the house of the king; and one third will be at the Gate of the Foundation; and all the people will be in the courtyards of the house of Jehovah.

11662.label: 2 Chronicles 23:6
11662.text: And do not let anyone enter the house of Jehovah but the priests and those of the Levites ministering. These are the ones that will enter, because they are a holy group, and all the people themselves will keep the obligation to Jehovah.

11663.label: 2 Chronicles 23:7
11663.text: And the Levites must encircle the king all around, each one with his weapons in his hands; and as for anyone coming into the house, he should be put to death. And continue with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”

11664.label: 2 Chronicles 23:8
11664.text: And the Levites and all Judah proceeded to do according to all that Je·hoiʹa·da the priest had commanded. So they took each one his men that were coming in on the sabbath together with those going out on the sabbath, for Je·hoiʹa·da the priest had not set the divisions free from duty.

11665.label: 2 Chronicles 23:9
11665.text: Further, Je·hoiʹa·da the priest gave the chiefs of hundreds the spears and the shields and the circular shields that had belonged to King David, which were in the house of the [true] God.

11666.label: 2 Chronicles 23:10
11666.text: And he went on to station all the people, even each one with his missile in his hand, from the right side of the house clear to the left side of the house, by the altar and by the house, all around near the king.

11667.label: 2 Chronicles 23:11
11667.text: Then they brought the king’s son out and put upon him the diadem and the Testimony and made him king, and so Je·hoiʹa·da and his sons anointed him and said: “Let the king live!”

11668.label: 2 Chronicles 23:12
11668.text: When Ath·a·liʹah heard the sound of the people running and praising the king, she at once came to the people at the house of Jehovah.

11669.label: 2 Chronicles 23:13
11669.text: Then she saw, and there was the king standing by his pillar at the entry, and the princes and the trumpets by the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing the trumpets, and the singers with the instruments of song and those giving the signal for offering praise. Immediately Ath·a·liʹah ripped her garments apart and said: “Conspiracy! Conspiracy!”

11670.label: 2 Chronicles 23:14
11670.text: But Je·hoiʹa·da the priest brought out the chiefs of hundreds, the appointed ones of the military force, and said to them: “Take her out from inside the rows; and as for anyone coming after her, he should be put to death with the sword!” For the priest had said: “YOU must not put her to death at the house of Jehovah.”

11671.label: 2 Chronicles 23:15
11671.text: So they laid their hands upon her. When she came to the entry of the horse gate of the king’s house, they at once put her to death there.

11672.label: 2 Chronicles 23:16
11672.text: Then Je·hoiʹa·da concluded a covenant between himself and all the people and the king that they would continue as the people of Jehovah.

11673.label: 2 Chronicles 23:17
11673.text: After that all the people came to the house of Baʹal and pulled it down; and his altars and his images they broke up, and Matʹtan the priest of Baʹal they killed before the altars.

11674.label: 2 Chronicles 23:18
11674.text: Further, Je·hoiʹa·da put the offices of the house of Jehovah in the hand of the priests [and] the Levites, whom David had put in divisions over the house of Jehovah to offer up the burnt sacrifices of Jehovah according to what is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with song by the hands of David.

11675.label: 2 Chronicles 23:19
11675.text: So he stationed the gatekeepers by the gates of the house of Jehovah that no one unclean in any respect might enter.

11676.label: 2 Chronicles 23:20
11676.text: He now took the chiefs of hundreds and the lordly ones and the rulers over the people and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the house of Jehovah. Then they came right through the upper gate to the king’s house and seated the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

11677.label: 2 Chronicles 23:21
11677.text: And all the people of the land continued to rejoice; and the city itself had no disturbance, and Ath·a·liʹah they had put to death with the sword.

11678.label: 2 Chronicles 24:1
11678.text: Seven years old was Je·hoʹash when he began to reign, and for forty years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibʹi·ah from Beʹer-sheʹba.

11679.label: 2 Chronicles 24:2
11679.text: And Je·hoʹash kept doing what was right in Jehovah’s eyes all the days of Je·hoiʹa·da the priest.

11680.label: 2 Chronicles 24:3
11680.text: And Je·hoiʹa·da proceeded to get two wives for him, and he came to be father to sons and daughters.

11681.label: 2 Chronicles 24:4
11681.text: Now it occurred afterward that it became close to the heart of Je·hoʹash to renovate the house of Jehovah.

11682.label: 2 Chronicles 24:5
11682.text: Accordingly he collected the priests and the Levites together and said to them: “Go out to the cities of Judah and collect money from all Israel to repair the house of YOUR God from year to year; and YOU, for YOUR part, should act quickly in the matter.” And the Levites did not act quickly.

11683.label: 2 Chronicles 24:6
11683.text: So the king called Je·hoiʹa·da the head and said to him: “Why is it that you have not required an account of the Levites for bringing in from Judah and Jerusalem the sacred tax ordered by Moses the servant of Jehovah, even that of the congregation of Israel, for the tent of the Testimony?

11684.label: 2 Chronicles 24:7
11684.text: For as regards Ath·a·liʹah the wicked woman, her sons themselves had broken into the house of the [true] God, and even all the holy things of the house of Jehovah they had rendered up to the Baʹals.”

11685.label: 2 Chronicles 24:8
11685.text: Then the king said [the word], and so they made a chest and put it outside at the gate of the house of Jehovah.

11686.label: 2 Chronicles 24:9
11686.text: After that they issued a call throughout Judah and Jerusalem to bring to Jehovah the sacred tax ordered by Moses the servant of the [true] God upon Israel in the wilderness.

11687.label: 2 Chronicles 24:10
11687.text: And all the princes and all the people began to rejoice, and they kept bringing and casting it into the chest until they all had given.

11688.label: 2 Chronicles 24:11
11688.text: And it came about at the proper time he would bring the chest to the care of the king by the hand of the Levites, and, as soon as they saw that there was plenty of money, the secretary of the king and the commissioner of the chief priest came and then emptied the chest and lifted it up and returned it to its place. That was the way they did from day to day, so that they gathered money in abundance.

11689.label: 2 Chronicles 24:12
11689.text: Then the king and Je·hoiʹa·da would give it to the doers of the work of the service of Jehovah’s house, and they came to be hirers of the stonecutters and of the craftsmen for renovating Jehovah’s house, and also of the workers in iron and copper for repairing Jehovah’s house.

11690.label: 2 Chronicles 24:13
11690.text: And the doers of the work began operations, and the repair work kept advancing by their hand, and finally they made the house of the [true] God stand as it structurally should and made it strong.

11691.label: 2 Chronicles 24:14
11691.text: And as soon as they had finished they brought before the king and Je·hoiʹa·da the rest of the money, and they proceeded to make utensils for the house of Jehovah, utensils for the ministry and for making offerings and cups and utensils of gold and of silver; and they came to be offerers of burnt sacrifices in the house of Jehovah constantly all the days of Je·hoiʹa·da.

11692.label: 2 Chronicles 24:15
11692.text: And Je·hoiʹa·da got to be old and satisfied with years and gradually died, being a hundred and thirty years old at his death.

11693.label: 2 Chronicles 24:16
11693.text: So they buried him in the City of David along with the kings, because he had done good in Israel and with the [true] God and His house.

11694.label: 2 Chronicles 24:17
11694.text: And after Je·hoiʹa·da’s death the princes of Judah came in and proceeded to bow down to the king. At that time the king listened to them.

11695.label: 2 Chronicles 24:18
11695.text: And gradually they left the house of Jehovah the God of their forefathers and began serving the sacred poles and the idols, so that there came to be indignation against Judah and Jerusalem because of this guilt of theirs.

11696.label: 2 Chronicles 24:19
11696.text: And he kept sending prophets among them to bring them back to Jehovah; and they kept bearing witness against them, but they did not give ear.

11697.label: 2 Chronicles 24:20
11697.text: And God’s spirit itself enveloped Zech·a·riʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·da the priest, so that he stood up above the people and said to them: “This is what the [true] God has said, ‘Why are YOU overstepping the commandments of Jehovah, so that YOU cannot prove successful? Because YOU have left Jehovah, he will, in turn, leave YOU.’”

11698.label: 2 Chronicles 24:21
11698.text: Finally they conspired against him and pelted him with stones at the king’s commandment in the courtyard of Jehovah’s house.

11699.label: 2 Chronicles 24:22
11699.text: And Je·hoʹash the king did not remember the loving-kindness that Je·hoiʹa·da his father had exercised toward him, so that he killed his son, who, when he was at the point of dying, said: “Let Jehovah see to it and ask it back.”

11700.label: 2 Chronicles 24:23
11700.text: And it came about at the turn of the year a military force of Syria came up against him, and they began to invade Judah and Jerusalem. Then they brought all the princes of the people to ruin from among the people, and all their spoil they sent to the king of Damascus.

11701.label: 2 Chronicles 24:24
11701.text: For it was with a small number of men that the military force of the Syrians made an invasion, and Jehovah himself gave into their hand a military force of very great number, because they had left Jehovah the God of their forefathers; and upon Je·hoʹash they executed acts of judgment.

11702.label: 2 Chronicles 24:25
11702.text: And when they went away from him (for they left him with many diseases), his own servants conspired against him because of the blood of the sons of Je·hoiʹa·da the priest; and they got to kill him upon his own couch, so that he died. Then they buried him in the City of David, but they did not bury him in the burial places of the kings.

11703.label: 2 Chronicles 24:26
11703.text: And these were the conspirators against him: Zaʹbad the son of Shimʹe·ath the Amʹmon·it·ess and Je·hozʹa·bad the son of Shimʹrith the Moʹab·i·tess.

11704.label: 2 Chronicles 24:27
11704.text: As for his sons and the abundance of the pronouncement against him and the founding of the house of the [true] God, there they are written in the exposition of the Book of the Kings. And Am·a·ziʹah his son began to reign in place of him.

11705.label: 2 Chronicles 25:1
11705.text: At the age of twenty-five years Am·a·ziʹah became king, and for twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Je·ho·adʹdan of Jerusalem.

11706.label: 2 Chronicles 25:2
11706.text: And he continued to do what was right in Jehovah’s eyes, only not with a complete heart.

11707.label: 2 Chronicles 25:3
11707.text: And it came about that as soon as the kingdom had become strong upon him, he promptly killed his servants who had struck down the king his father.

11708.label: 2 Chronicles 25:4
11708.text: And their sons he did not put to death, but [did] according to what is written in the law, in the book of Moses, that Jehovah commanded, saying: “Fathers should not die for sons, neither should sons themselves die for fathers; but it is each one for his own sin that they should die.”

11709.label: 2 Chronicles 25:5
11709.text: And Am·a·ziʹah proceeded to collect Judah together and to have them stand according to the house of the forefathers, by the chiefs of thousands and by the chiefs of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin; and he went on to register them from twenty years of age upward, and finally he found them [to be] three hundred thousand choice men going out to the army, handling lance and large shield.

11710.label: 2 Chronicles 25:6
11710.text: Further, he hired from Israel a hundred thousand valiant, mighty men for a hundred silver talents.

11711.label: 2 Chronicles 25:7
11711.text: And a certain man of the [true] God came to him, saying: “O king, do not let the army of Israel come with you, for Jehovah is not with Israel, [that is,] all the sons of Eʹphra·im.

11712.label: 2 Chronicles 25:8
11712.text: But come you yourself, act, be courageous for the war. The [true] God could cause you to stumble before an enemy; for there exists power with God to help and to cause stumbling.”

11713.label: 2 Chronicles 25:9
11713.text: At this Am·a·ziʹah said to the man of the [true] God: “But what is there to do about the hundred talents that I have given to the troops of Israel?” To this the man of the [true] God said: “There exists with Jehovah the means to give you much more than this.”

11714.label: 2 Chronicles 25:10
11714.text: Accordingly Am·a·ziʹah separated them, namely, the troops that had come to him from Eʹphra·im, to go to their own place. However, their anger got very hot against Judah, so that they returned to their own place in the heat of anger.

11715.label: 2 Chronicles 25:11
11715.text: And Am·a·ziʹah, for his part, took courage and proceeded to lead his own people and go to the Valley of Salt; and he went striking down the sons of Seʹir, ten thousand [of them].

11716.label: 2 Chronicles 25:12
11716.text: And there were ten thousand that the sons of Judah captured alive. So they brought them to the top of the crag, and proceeded to throw them from the top of the crag; and they, one and all, burst apart.

11717.label: 2 Chronicles 25:13
11717.text: As for the members of the troop whom Am·a·ziʹah had sent back from going with him to the war, they began making raids upon the cities of Judah, from Sa·marʹi·a clear to Beth-hoʹron, and went striking down three thousand of them and taking a great plunder.

11718.label: 2 Chronicles 25:14
11718.text: But it occurred after Am·a·ziʹah came from striking down the Eʹdom·ites that he now brought the gods of the sons of Seʹir and set them up for himself as gods, and before them he began to bow down, and to them he began to make sacrificial smoke.

11719.label: 2 Chronicles 25:15
11719.text: Consequently Jehovah’s anger became hot against Am·a·ziʹah, and so he sent a prophet to him and said to him: “Why have you searched for the people’s gods that did not deliver their own people out of your hand?”

11720.label: 2 Chronicles 25:16
11720.text: And it came about when he spoke to him that [the king] immediately said to him: “Was it a counselor of the king that we constituted you? Quit for your own sake. Why should they strike you down?” Accordingly the prophet quit, but he said: “I certainly know that God has resolved to bring you to ruin, because you have done this and you have not listened to my counsel.”

11721.label: 2 Chronicles 25:17
11721.text: Then Am·a·ziʹah the king of Judah took counsel and sent to Je·hoʹash the son of Je·hoʹa·haz the son of Jeʹhu the king of Israel, saying: “Come! Let us look each other in the face.”

11722.label: 2 Chronicles 25:18
11722.text: At that Je·hoʹash the king of Israel sent to Am·a·ziʹah the king of Judah, saying: “The thorny weed itself that was in Lebʹa·non sent to the cedar that was in Lebʹa·non, saying, ‘Do give your daughter to my son as a wife.’ However, a wild beast of the field that was in Lebʹa·non passed by and trampled the thorny weed down.

11723.label: 2 Chronicles 25:19
11723.text: You have said to yourself, Here you have struck down Eʹdom. And your heart has lifted you up to be glorified. Now do keep dwelling in your own house. Why should you engage in strife in a bad position and have to fall, you and Judah with you?”

11724.label: 2 Chronicles 25:20
11724.text: But Am·a·ziʹah did not listen; for it was from the [true] God for the purpose of giving them into his hand, because they had searched for the gods of Eʹdom.

11725.label: 2 Chronicles 25:21
11725.text: So Je·hoʹash the king of Israel went up, and they proceeded to look each other in the face, he and Am·a·ziʹah the king of Judah, at Beth-sheʹmesh, which belongs to Judah.

11726.label: 2 Chronicles 25:22
11726.text: And Judah came to be defeated before Israel, so that they took to flight each one to his tent.

11727.label: 2 Chronicles 25:23
11727.text: And it was Am·a·ziʹah the king of Judah, the son of Je·hoʹash the son of Je·hoʹa·haz, that Je·hoʹash the king of Israel seized at Beth-sheʹmesh, after which he brought him to Jerusalem and made a breach in the wall of Jerusalem, from the Gate of Eʹphra·im clear to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.

11728.label: 2 Chronicles 25:24
11728.text: And [he took] all the gold and the silver and all the articles that were to be found in the house of the [true] God with Oʹbed-eʹdom and the treasures of the king’s house and the hostages, and then returned to Sa·marʹi·a.

11729.label: 2 Chronicles 25:25
11729.text: And Am·a·ziʹah the son of Je·hoʹash the king of Judah continued to live after the death of Je·hoʹash the son of Je·hoʹa·haz the king of Israel fifteen years.

11730.label: 2 Chronicles 25:26
11730.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Am·a·ziʹah, the first and the last, look! are they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?

11731.label: 2 Chronicles 25:27
11731.text: And from the time that Am·a·ziʹah turned aside from following Jehovah, they proceeded to form a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. At length he fled to Laʹchish; but they sent after him to Laʹchish and put him to death there.

11732.label: 2 Chronicles 25:28
11732.text: So they carried him upon horses and buried him with his forefathers in the city of Judah.

11733.label: 2 Chronicles 26:1
11733.text: Then all the people of Judah took Uz·ziʹah, he being sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Am·a·ziʹah.

11734.label: 2 Chronicles 26:2
11734.text: He it was that rebuilt Eʹloth and then restored it to Judah after the king had lain down with his forefathers.

11735.label: 2 Chronicles 26:3
11735.text: Sixteen years old was Uz·ziʹah when he began to reign, and for fifty-two years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Je·co·liʹah of Jerusalem.

11736.label: 2 Chronicles 26:4
11736.text: And he kept doing what was right in Jehovah’s eyes, according to all that Am·a·ziʹah his father had done.

11737.label: 2 Chronicles 26:5
11737.text: And he continually tended to search for God in the days of Zech·a·riʹah, the instructor in the fear of the [true] God; and, in the days of his searching for Jehovah, the [true] God made him prosperous.

11738.label: 2 Chronicles 26:6
11738.text: And he proceeded to go out and fight against the Phi·lisʹtines and break through the wall of Gath and the wall of Jabʹneh and the wall of Ashʹdod, after which he built cities in Ashʹdod [territory] and among the Phi·lisʹtines.

11739.label: 2 Chronicles 26:7
11739.text: And the [true] God continued to help him against the Phi·lisʹtines and against the Arabians that were dwelling in Gur·baʹal and the Me·uʹnim.

11740.label: 2 Chronicles 26:8
11740.text: And the Amʹmon·ites began to give tribute to Uz·ziʹah. Eventually his fame went even as far as Egypt, for he displayed strength to an extraordinary degree.

11741.label: 2 Chronicles 26:9
11741.text: Moreover, Uz·ziʹah built towers in Jerusalem by the Corner Gate and by the Valley Gate and by the Buttress, and made them strong.

11742.label: 2 Chronicles 26:10
11742.text: Further, he built towers in the wilderness, and hewed out many cisterns (for there was a great deal of livestock that became his), and also in the She·pheʹlah and on the tableland. There were farmers and vinedressers in the mountains and in Carʹmel, for a lover of agriculture he proved to be.

11743.label: 2 Chronicles 26:11
11743.text: Moreover, Uz·ziʹah came to have a force engaging in war, those going out on military service in troops, by the number of their registration by the hand of Je·iʹel the secretary and Ma·a·seiʹah the officer under the control of Han·a·niʹah of the king’s princes.

11744.label: 2 Chronicles 26:12
11744.text: The entire number of the heads of the paternal houses, of the valiant, mighty men, was two thousand six hundred.

11745.label: 2 Chronicles 26:13
11745.text: And under their control the army forces were three hundred and seven thousand five hundred men engaging in war with the power of a military force to help the king against the enemy.

11746.label: 2 Chronicles 26:14
11746.text: And Uz·ziʹah continued to prepare for them, for the entire army, shields and lances and helmets and coats of mail and bows and slingstones.

11747.label: 2 Chronicles 26:15
11747.text: Further, he made in Jerusalem engines of war, the invention of engineers, that they might come to be upon the towers and upon the corners, to shoot arrows and great stones. Consequently his fame went out to a great distance, for he was helped wonderfully until he was strong.

11748.label: 2 Chronicles 26:16
11748.text: However, as soon as he was strong, his heart became haughty even to the point of causing ruin, so that he acted unfaithfully against Jehovah his God and came into the temple of Jehovah to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

11749.label: 2 Chronicles 26:17
11749.text: Immediately Az·a·riʹah the priest and with him priests of Jehovah, eighty valiant men, came in after him.

11750.label: 2 Chronicles 26:18
11750.text: Then they stood up against Uz·ziʹah the king and said to him: “It is not your business, O Uz·ziʹah, to burn incense to Jehovah, but it is the business of the priests the sons of Aaron, the ones sanctified, to burn incense. Go out from the sanctuary; for you have acted unfaithfully, and it is not for any glory to you on the part of Jehovah God.”

11751.label: 2 Chronicles 26:19
11751.text: But Uz·ziʹah became enraged while in his hand there was a censer for burning incense, and, during his rage against the priests, leprosy itself flashed up in his forehead before the priests in the house of Jehovah beside the altar of incense.

11752.label: 2 Chronicles 26:20
11752.text: When Az·a·riʹah the chief priest and all the priests turned toward him, why, there he was stricken with leprosy in his forehead! So they excitedly began to remove him from there, and he himself also hastened to go out, because Jehovah had smitten him.

11753.label: 2 Chronicles 26:21
11753.text: And Uz·ziʹah the king continued to be a leper until the day of his death, and he kept dwelling in a house exempt from duties, as a leper; for he had been severed from the house of Jehovah, while Joʹtham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

11754.label: 2 Chronicles 26:22
11754.text: And the rest of the affairs of Uz·ziʹah, the first and the last, Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz the prophet has written.

11755.label: 2 Chronicles 26:23
11755.text: Finally Uz·ziʹah lay down with his forefathers; and so they buried him with his forefathers, [but] in the burial field that belonged to the kings, for they said: “He is a leper.” And Joʹtham his son began to reign in place of him.

11756.label: 2 Chronicles 27:1
11756.text: Twenty-five years old was Joʹtham when he began to reign, and for sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Je·ruʹshah the daughter of Zaʹdok.

11757.label: 2 Chronicles 27:2
11757.text: And he kept doing what was right in Jehovah’s eyes, according to all that Uz·ziʹah his father had done. Only he did not invade the temple of Jehovah. However, the people were yet acting ruinously.

11758.label: 2 Chronicles 27:3
11758.text: He himself built the upper gate of Jehovah’s house, and on the wall of Oʹphel he did a great deal of building.

11759.label: 2 Chronicles 27:4
11759.text: And cities he built in the mountainous region of Judah, and in the woodlands he built fortified places and towers.

11760.label: 2 Chronicles 27:5
11760.text: And he himself warred against the king of the sons of Amʹmon and eventually proved stronger than they were, so that the sons of Amʹmon gave him in that year a hundred silver talents and ten thousand cor measures of wheat and ten thousand of barley. This was what the sons of Amʹmon paid to him, also in the second year and the third.

11761.label: 2 Chronicles 27:6
11761.text: So Joʹtham kept strengthening himself, for he prepared his ways before Jehovah his God.

11762.label: 2 Chronicles 27:7
11762.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Joʹtham and all his wars and his ways, there they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and of Judah.

11763.label: 2 Chronicles 27:8
11763.text: Twenty-five years old he happened to be when he began to reign, and for sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem.

11764.label: 2 Chronicles 27:9
11764.text: Finally Joʹtham lay down with his forefathers, and they buried him in the City of David. And Aʹhaz his son began to reign in place of him.

11765.label: 2 Chronicles 28:1
11765.text: Twenty years old was Aʹhaz when he began to reign, and for sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, and he did not do what was right in Jehovah’s eyes like David his forefather.

11766.label: 2 Chronicles 28:2
11766.text: But he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and even molten statues he made of the Baʹals.

11767.label: 2 Chronicles 28:3
11767.text: And he himself made sacrificial smoke in the valley of the son of Hinʹnom and proceeded to burn up his sons in the fire, according to the detestable things of the nations that Jehovah had driven out from before the sons of Israel.

11768.label: 2 Chronicles 28:4
11768.text: And he regularly sacrificed and made sacrificial smoke on the high places and upon the hills and under every sort of luxuriant tree.

11769.label: 2 Chronicles 28:5
11769.text: Consequently Jehovah his God gave him into the hand of the king of Syria, so that they struck him and carried off from him a great number of captives and brought them to Damascus. And also into the hand of the king of Israel he was given, so that he struck him with a great slaughter.

11770.label: 2 Chronicles 28:6
11770.text: Accordingly Peʹkah the son of Rem·a·liʹah killed in Judah a hundred and twenty thousand in one day, all valiant men, because of their leaving Jehovah the God of their forefathers.

11771.label: 2 Chronicles 28:7
11771.text: Further, Zichʹri, a mighty man of Eʹphra·im, killed Ma·a·seiʹah the son of the king and Az·riʹkam the leader of the household and El·kaʹnah the one next to the king.

11772.label: 2 Chronicles 28:8
11772.text: Moreover, the sons of Israel took two hundred thousand of their brothers captive, women, sons and daughters; and also a great deal of spoil they took from them as plunder, after which they brought the spoil to Sa·marʹi·a.

11773.label: 2 Chronicles 28:9
11773.text: And there happened to be a prophet of Jehovah there whose name was Oʹded. So he went out before the army that was coming to Sa·marʹi·a and said to them: “Look! It was because of the rage of Jehovah the God of YOUR forefathers against Judah that he gave them into YOUR hand, so that YOU did a killing among them with a raging that has reached clear to the heavens.

11774.label: 2 Chronicles 28:10
11774.text: And now the sons of Judah and of Jerusalem YOU are thinking of reducing to menservants and maidservants for yourselves. Nevertheless, are there not with YOU yourselves cases of guilt against Jehovah YOUR God?

11775.label: 2 Chronicles 28:11
11775.text: And now listen to me and return the captives that you have captured from YOUR brothers, for Jehovah’s burning anger is against YOU.”

11776.label: 2 Chronicles 28:12
11776.text: At that [certain] men of the heads of the sons of Eʹphra·im, Az·a·riʹah the son of Je·ho·haʹnan, Ber·e·chiʹah the son of Me·shilʹle·moth and Je·hiz·kiʹah the son of Shalʹlum and A·maʹsa the son of Hadʹlai, rose up against those coming in from the military campaign,

11777.label: 2 Chronicles 28:13
11777.text: and they said to them: “YOU must not bring in the captives here, for it will result in guilt against Jehovah on our part. YOU are thinking of adding to our sins and to our guilt, for abundant is the guilt we have, and there is burning anger against Israel.”

11778.label: 2 Chronicles 28:14
11778.text: Accordingly the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the congregation.

11779.label: 2 Chronicles 28:15
11779.text: Then the men that were designated by their names rose up and took hold of the captives, and all their naked ones they clothed from the spoil. So they clothed them and furnished them with sandals and fed them and gave them drink and greased them. Furthermore, in the case of anyone tottering, they gave them transportation on the asses and brought them to Jerʹi·cho, the city of palm trees, beside their brothers. After that they returned to Sa·marʹi·a.

11780.label: 2 Chronicles 28:16
11780.text: At that time King Aʹhaz sent to the kings of As·syrʹi·a for them to help him.

11781.label: 2 Chronicles 28:17
11781.text: And once again the Eʹdom·ites themselves came in and went striking down Judah and carrying off captives.

11782.label: 2 Chronicles 28:18
11782.text: As for the Phi·lisʹtines, they made a raid upon the cities of the She·pheʹlah and the Negʹeb of Judah and got to capture Beth-sheʹmesh and Aiʹja·lon and Ge·deʹroth and Soʹco and its dependent towns and Timʹnah and its dependent towns and Gimʹzo and its dependent towns; and they took up dwelling there.

11783.label: 2 Chronicles 28:19
11783.text: For Jehovah humbled Judah on account of Aʹhaz the king of Israel, because he let unrestraint grow in Judah, and there was an acting with great unfaithfulness toward Jehovah.

11784.label: 2 Chronicles 28:20
11784.text: Eventually Tilʹgath-pil·neʹser the king of As·syrʹi·a came against him and caused him distress, and did not strengthen him.

11785.label: 2 Chronicles 28:21
11785.text: For Aʹhaz stripped the house of Jehovah and the house of the king and of the princes and thus made a gift to the king of As·syrʹi·a; but it was of no assistance to him.

11786.label: 2 Chronicles 28:22
11786.text: However, at the time that he was causing him distress, he acted unfaithfully still more toward Jehovah, that is, King Aʹhaz did.

11787.label: 2 Chronicles 28:23
11787.text: And he began to sacrifice to the gods of Damascus that were striking him, and he went on to say: “Because the gods of the kings of Syria are helping them, to them I shall sacrifice, that they may help me.” And they themselves became to him a cause for making him and all Israel stumble.

11788.label: 2 Chronicles 28:24
11788.text: Furthermore, Aʹhaz gathered together the utensils of the house of the [true] God and cut to pieces the utensils of the house of the [true] God, and closed the doors of the house of Jehovah, and made altars for himself at every corner in Jerusalem.

11789.label: 2 Chronicles 28:25
11789.text: And in all cities, even the cities of Judah, he made high places for making sacrificial smoke to other gods, so that he offended Jehovah the God of his forefathers.

11790.label: 2 Chronicles 28:26
11790.text: As for the rest of his affairs and all his ways, the first and the last, there they are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and of Israel.

11791.label: 2 Chronicles 28:27
11791.text: Finally Aʹhaz lay down with his forefathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem, for they did not bring him into the burial places of the kings of Israel. And Hez·e·kiʹah his son began to reign in place of him.

11792.label: 2 Chronicles 29:1
11792.text: Hez·e·kiʹah himself became king at the age of twenty-five years, and for twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was A·biʹjah the daughter of Zech·a·riʹah.

11793.label: 2 Chronicles 29:2
11793.text: And he kept doing what was right in Jehovah’s eyes, according to all that David his forefather had done.

11794.label: 2 Chronicles 29:3
11794.text: He himself, in the first year of his reigning, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of Jehovah and began to repair them.

11795.label: 2 Chronicles 29:4
11795.text: Then he brought the priests and the Levites and gathered them to the open place to the east.

11796.label: 2 Chronicles 29:5
11796.text: And he proceeded to say to them: “Listen to me, YOU Levites. Now sanctify yourselves and sanctify the house of Jehovah the God of YOUR forefathers, and bring the impure thing out from the holy place.

11797.label: 2 Chronicles 29:6
11797.text: For our fathers have acted unfaithfully and have done what was bad in the eyes of Jehovah our God, so that they left him and turned around their face away from the tabernacle of Jehovah and offered the back of the neck.

11798.label: 2 Chronicles 29:7
11798.text: They also closed the doors of the porch and kept the lamps extinguished, and incense they did not burn, and burnt sacrifice they did not offer up in the holy place to the God of Israel.

11799.label: 2 Chronicles 29:8
11799.text: And Jehovah’s indignation came to be against Judah and Jerusalem, so that he constituted them an object at which to quake, an object of astonishment and a cause for whistling, just as YOU are seeing with YOUR own eyes.

11800.label: 2 Chronicles 29:9
11800.text: And here our forefathers fell by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives were in captivity for this.

11801.label: 2 Chronicles 29:10
11801.text: Now it is close to my heart to conclude a covenant with Jehovah the God of Israel, that his burning anger may turn back from us.

11802.label: 2 Chronicles 29:11
11802.text: Now, my sons, do not give yourselves up to rest, for YOU are the ones whom Jehovah has chosen to stand before him to minister to him and to continue as his ministers and makers of sacrificial smoke.”

11803.label: 2 Chronicles 29:12
11803.text: At that the Levites rose up, Maʹhath the son of A·maʹsai and Joel the son of Az·a·riʹah of the sons of the Koʹhath·ites; and from the sons of Me·rarʹi, Kish the son of Abʹdi and Az·a·riʹah the son of Je·halʹle·lel; and from the Gerʹshon·ites, Joʹah the son of Zimʹmah and Eʹden the son of Joʹah;

11804.label: 2 Chronicles 29:13
11804.text: and from the sons of E·li·zaʹphan, Shimʹri and Je·uʹel; and from the sons of Aʹsaph, Zech·a·riʹah and Mat·ta·niʹah;

11805.label: 2 Chronicles 29:14
11805.text: and from the sons of Heʹman, Je·hiʹel and Shimʹe·i; and from the sons of Je·duʹthun, She·maiʹah and Uzʹzi·el.

11806.label: 2 Chronicles 29:15
11806.text: Then they gathered their brothers together and sanctified themselves and came according to the king’s commandment in the words of Jehovah, to cleanse the house of Jehovah.

11807.label: 2 Chronicles 29:16
11807.text: The priests now came inside the house of Jehovah to do the cleansing and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of Jehovah to the courtyard of the house of Jehovah. In turn the Levites received it to take it out to the torrent valley of Kidʹron outside.

11808.label: 2 Chronicles 29:17
11808.text: Thus they got started on the first [day] of the first month at sanctifying, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of Jehovah; so that they sanctified the house of Jehovah in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

11809.label: 2 Chronicles 29:18
11809.text: After that they came inside to Hez·e·kiʹah the king and said: “We have cleansed the whole house of Jehovah, the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the table of the layer bread and all its utensils.

11810.label: 2 Chronicles 29:19
11810.text: And all the utensils that King Aʹhaz removed from employment during his reign in his unfaithfulness we have prepared, and have sanctified them; and there they are before the altar of Jehovah.”

11811.label: 2 Chronicles 29:20
11811.text: And Hez·e·kiʹah the king proceeded to get up early and gather the princes of the city together and go up to the house of Jehovah.

11812.label: 2 Chronicles 29:21
11812.text: And they came bringing seven bulls and seven rams and seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom and for the sanctuary and for Judah. So he said to the sons of Aaron the priests to offer them up upon the altar of Jehovah.

11813.label: 2 Chronicles 29:22
11813.text: Accordingly they slaughtered the cattle and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it upon the altar; after which they slaughtered the rams and sprinkled the blood upon the altar, and they slaughtered the male lambs and sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

11814.label: 2 Chronicles 29:23
11814.text: Then they brought the male goats of the sin offering near before the king and the congregation and laid their hands upon them.

11815.label: 2 Chronicles 29:24
11815.text: The priests now slaughtered them and made a sin offering with their blood upon the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; because it was for all Israel that the king said the burnt offering and the sin offering [should be].

11816.label: 2 Chronicles 29:25
11816.text: Meantime, he had the Levites stationed at the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, with stringed instruments and with harps, by the commandment of David and of Gad the king’s visionary and of Nathan the prophet, for it was by the hand of Jehovah that the commandment was by means of his prophets.

11817.label: 2 Chronicles 29:26
11817.text: So the Levites kept standing with the instruments of David, and also the priests with the trumpets.

11818.label: 2 Chronicles 29:27
11818.text: Then Hez·e·kiʹah said to offer up the burnt sacrifice on the altar; and at the time that the burnt offering started, the song of Jehovah started and also the trumpets, even under the direction of the instruments of David the king of Israel.

11819.label: 2 Chronicles 29:28
11819.text: And all the congregation were bowing down while the song was resounding and the trumpets were blaring—all this until the burnt offering was finished.

11820.label: 2 Chronicles 29:29
11820.text: And as soon as they finished offering it up, the king and all those found with him bowed low and prostrated themselves.

11821.label: 2 Chronicles 29:30
11821.text: Hez·e·kiʹah the king and the princes now said to the Levites to praise Jehovah in the words of David and of Aʹsaph the visionary. So they began to offer praise even with rejoicing, and they kept bending down and prostrating themselves.

11822.label: 2 Chronicles 29:31
11822.text: Finally Hez·e·kiʹah answered and said: “Now YOU have filled YOUR hand with power for Jehovah. Approach, and bring sacrifices and thanksgiving sacrifices to the house of Jehovah.” And the congregation began to bring sacrifices and thanksgiving sacrifices, and also every one willing of heart, burnt offerings.

11823.label: 2 Chronicles 29:32
11823.text: And the number of the burnt offerings that the congregation brought came to be seventy cattle, a hundred rams, two hundred male lambs—all these as a burnt offering to Jehovah;

11824.label: 2 Chronicles 29:33
11824.text: and also the holy offerings, six hundred cattle and three thousand of the flock.

11825.label: 2 Chronicles 29:34
11825.text: Only the priests themselves happened to be too few, and they were not able to skin all the burnt offerings. So their brothers the Levites helped them out until the work was finished and until the priests could sanctify themselves, for the Levites were more upright of heart for sanctifying themselves than the priests.

11826.label: 2 Chronicles 29:35
11826.text: And, too, the burnt offerings were in great quantity with the fat pieces of the communion sacrifices and with the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. Thus the service of the house of Jehovah was prepared.

11827.label: 2 Chronicles 29:36
11827.text: Consequently Hez·e·kiʹah and all the people rejoiced over the fact that the [true] God had made preparation for the people, because it was all of a sudden that the thing had occurred.

11828.label: 2 Chronicles 30:1
11828.text: And Hez·e·kiʹah proceeded to send to all Israel and Judah, and even letters he wrote to Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh, to come to the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem to hold the passover to Jehovah the God of Israel.

11829.label: 2 Chronicles 30:2
11829.text: However, the king and his princes and all the congregation in Jerusalem resolved to hold the passover in the second month;

11830.label: 2 Chronicles 30:3
11830.text: for they had not been able to hold it at that time, because not enough priests, on the one hand, had sanctified themselves and the people, on the other hand, had not gathered themselves to Jerusalem.

11831.label: 2 Chronicles 30:4
11831.text: And the thing was right in the eyes of the king and in the eyes of all the congregation.

11832.label: 2 Chronicles 30:5
11832.text: So they decided to have the call pass through all Israel, from Beʹer-sheʹba to Dan, to come and hold the passover to Jehovah the God of Israel at Jerusalem; for it was not as a multitude that they had done so according to what is written.

11833.label: 2 Chronicles 30:6
11833.text: Accordingly the runners with the letters from the hand of the king and of his princes went throughout all Israel and Judah, even according to the commandment of the king, saying: “YOU sons of Israel, return to Jehovah the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to the escaped ones that are left of YOU out of the palm of the kings of As·syrʹi·a.

11834.label: 2 Chronicles 30:7
11834.text: And do not become like YOUR forefathers and like YOUR brothers that acted unfaithfully toward Jehovah the God of their forefathers, so that he constituted them an object of astonishment, just as YOU are seeing.

11835.label: 2 Chronicles 30:8
11835.text: Now do not stiffen YOUR neck as YOUR forefathers did. Give place to Jehovah and come to his sanctuary that he has sanctified to time indefinite and serve Jehovah YOUR God, that his burning anger may turn back from YOU.

11836.label: 2 Chronicles 30:9
11836.text: For when YOU return to Jehovah, YOUR brothers and YOUR sons will be objects of mercy before those holding them captive, and be allowed to return to this land; for Jehovah YOUR God is gracious and merciful, and he will not turn away the face from YOU if YOU return to him.”

11837.label: 2 Chronicles 30:10
11837.text: So the runners continued on, passing along from city to city throughout the land of Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh, even to Zebʹu·lun; but they were continually speaking in mockery of them and deriding them.

11838.label: 2 Chronicles 30:11
11838.text: Only individuals from Ashʹer and Ma·nasʹseh and from Zebʹu·lun humbled themselves so that they came to Jerusalem.

11839.label: 2 Chronicles 30:12
11839.text: The hand of the [true] God proved to be also in Judah to give them one heart to perform the commandment of the king and the princes in the matter of Jehovah.

11840.label: 2 Chronicles 30:13
11840.text: And they proceeded to gather themselves together at Jerusalem, a numerous people, to hold the festival of the unfermented cakes in the second month, a congregation very multitudinous.

11841.label: 2 Chronicles 30:14
11841.text: Then they rose up and removed the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the incense altars they removed and then threw [them] into the torrent valley of Kidʹron.

11842.label: 2 Chronicles 30:15
11842.text: After that they slaughtered the passover victim on the fourteenth [day] of the second month; and the priests and the Levites themselves had been humiliated, so that they sanctified themselves and brought burnt offerings to the house of Jehovah.

11843.label: 2 Chronicles 30:16
11843.text: And they kept standing at their place according to their rule, according to the law of Moses the man of the [true] God, the priests sprinkling the blood received from the hand of the Levites.

11844.label: 2 Chronicles 30:17
11844.text: For there were many in the congregation that had not sanctified themselves; and the Levites were in charge of slaughtering the passover victims for all that were not clean, to sanctify them to Jehovah.

11845.label: 2 Chronicles 30:18
11845.text: For there was a great number of the people, many from Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh, Isʹsa·char and Zebʹu·lun, that had not cleansed themselves, for they did not eat the passover according to what is written; but Hez·e·kiʹah prayed for them, saying: “May the good Jehovah himself make allowance for

11846.label: 2 Chronicles 30:19
11846.text: every one that has prepared his heart to search for the [true] God, Jehovah, the God of his forefathers, though without the purification for what is holy.”

11847.label: 2 Chronicles 30:20
11847.text: Accordingly Jehovah listened to Hez·e·kiʹah and healed the people.

11848.label: 2 Chronicles 30:21
11848.text: So the sons of Israel that were found in Jerusalem held the festival of the unfermented cakes seven days with great rejoicing; and the Levites and the priests were offering praise to Jehovah day by day with loud instruments, even to Jehovah.

11849.label: 2 Chronicles 30:22
11849.text: Moreover, Hez·e·kiʹah spoke to the heart of all the Levites who were acting with fine discretion toward Jehovah. And they proceeded to eat the appointed feast for seven days, sacrificing communion sacrifices and making confession to Jehovah the God of their forefathers.

11850.label: 2 Chronicles 30:23
11850.text: Then all the congregation decided to hold it for seven more days, and so they held it for seven days with rejoicing.

11851.label: 2 Chronicles 30:24
11851.text: For Hez·e·kiʹah the king of Judah himself contributed for the congregation a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep, and the princes themselves contributed for the congregation a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and priests kept sanctifying themselves in great number.

11852.label: 2 Chronicles 30:25
11852.text: And all the congregation of Judah and the priests and the Levites and all the congregation that came from Israel and the alien residents that came from the land of Israel and those dwelling in Judah continued rejoicing.

11853.label: 2 Chronicles 30:26
11853.text: And there came to be great rejoicing in Jerusalem, for from the days of Solʹo·mon the son of David the king of Israel there was none like this in Jerusalem.

11854.label: 2 Chronicles 30:27
11854.text: Finally the priests, the Levites, stood up and blessed the people; and a hearing was granted to their voice, so that their prayer came to his holy dwelling, the heavens.

11855.label: 2 Chronicles 31:1
11855.text: And as soon as they finished all this, all the Israelites that were found [there] went out to the cities of Judah, and they proceeded to break up the sacred pillars and cut down the sacred poles and pull down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin and in Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh until they had finished; after which all the sons of Israel returned to their cities, each one to his own possession.

11856.label: 2 Chronicles 31:2
11856.text: Then Hez·e·kiʹah set the divisions of the priests and of the Levites in their divisions, each one in accordance with its service for the priests and for the Levites as regards the burnt offering and the communion sacrifices to minister and to give thanks and praise in the gates of the camps of Jehovah.

11857.label: 2 Chronicles 31:3
11857.text: And there was a portion of the king from his own goods for the burnt offerings, for the burnt offerings of the morning and the evening, and also the burnt offerings for the sabbaths and for the new moons and for the festival seasons, according to what is written in the law of Jehovah.

11858.label: 2 Chronicles 31:4
11858.text: Furthermore, he said to the people, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to give the portion of the priests and of the Levites, in order that they might adhere strictly to the law of Jehovah.

11859.label: 2 Chronicles 31:5
11859.text: And as soon as the word broke forth, the sons of Israel increased the firstfruits of the grain, new wine, and oil and honey and all the produce of the field, and the tenth of everything they brought in abundantly.

11860.label: 2 Chronicles 31:6
11860.text: And the sons of Israel and of Judah that were dwelling in the cities of Judah, even they themselves [brought in] the tenth of cattle and sheep and the tenth of the holy things, the things sanctified to Jehovah their God. They brought in and so gave heaps upon heaps.

11861.label: 2 Chronicles 31:7
11861.text: In the third month they started the heaps by laying the lowest layer, and in the seventh month they finished.

11862.label: 2 Chronicles 31:8
11862.text: When Hez·e·kiʹah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they proceeded to bless Jehovah and his people Israel.

11863.label: 2 Chronicles 31:9
11863.text: In time Hez·e·kiʹah inquired of the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

11864.label: 2 Chronicles 31:10
11864.text: Then Az·a·riʹah the chief priest of the house of Zaʹdok said to him, yes, he said: “From the time they started to bring the contribution into the house of Jehovah there has been an eating and getting satisfied and having a surplus in abundance; for Jehovah himself has blessed his people, and what has been left over is this great plenty.”

11865.label: 2 Chronicles 31:11
11865.text: At this Hez·e·kiʹah said to prepare dining rooms in the house of Jehovah. Accordingly they prepared [them].

11866.label: 2 Chronicles 31:12
11866.text: And they kept bringing in the contribution and the tenth and the holy things in faithfulness; and Con·a·niʹah the Levite was in charge of them as leader, and Shimʹe·i his brother was second.

11867.label: 2 Chronicles 31:13
11867.text: And Je·hiʹel and Az·a·ziʹah and Naʹhath and Asʹa·hel and Jerʹi·moth and Joʹza·bad and Eʹli·el and Is·ma·chiʹah and Maʹhath and Be·naiʹah were commissioners at the side of Con·a·niʹah and Shimʹe·i his brother, by the order of Hez·e·kiʹah the king, and Az·a·riʹah was the leading one of the house of the [true] God.

11868.label: 2 Chronicles 31:14
11868.text: And Koʹre the son of Imʹnah the Levite was the gatekeeper to the east, in charge of the voluntary offerings of the [true] God, to give Jehovah’s contribution and the most holy things.

11869.label: 2 Chronicles 31:15
11869.text: And under his control there were Eʹden and Mi·niʹa·min and Jeshʹu·a and She·maiʹah, Am·a·riʹah and Shec·a·niʹah, in the cities of the priests, in office of trust, to give to their brothers in the divisions, equally to great and small;

11870.label: 2 Chronicles 31:16
11870.text: apart from their genealogical enrollment of the males from three years of age upward, of all those coming to the house of Jehovah as a daily matter of course, for their service by their obligations according to their divisions.

11871.label: 2 Chronicles 31:17
11871.text: This is the genealogical enrollment of the priests by the house of their fathers and also of the Levites, from the age of twenty years upward, by their obligations in their divisions;

11872.label: 2 Chronicles 31:18
11872.text: both for the genealogical enrollment among all their little ones, their wives and their sons and their daughters, for all the congregation, because in their office of trust they proceeded to sanctify themselves for what was holy;

11873.label: 2 Chronicles 31:19
11873.text: and for the sons of Aaron, the priests, in the fields of pasture ground of their cities. In all the different cities there were men that had been designated by [their] names, to give portions to every male among the priests and to the entire genealogical enrollment among the Levites.

11874.label: 2 Chronicles 31:20
11874.text: And Hez·e·kiʹah proceeded to do like this in all Judah, and he continued to do what was good and right and faithful before Jehovah his God.

11875.label: 2 Chronicles 31:21
11875.text: And in every work that he started in the service of the house of the [true] God and in the law and in the commandment to search for his God, it was with all his heart that he acted, and he proved successful.

11876.label: 2 Chronicles 32:1
11876.text: After these things and this faithful course Sen·nachʹer·ib the king of As·syrʹi·a came and proceeded to invade Judah and camp against the fortified cities, and kept thinking of making them his by a breakthrough.

11877.label: 2 Chronicles 32:2
11877.text: When Hez·e·kiʹah saw that Sen·nachʹer·ib had come with his face set for war against Jerusalem,

11878.label: 2 Chronicles 32:3
11878.text: then he decided with his princes and his mighty men to stop up the waters of the springs that were outside the city; and so they helped him.

11879.label: 2 Chronicles 32:4
11879.text: Accordingly many people were collected together, and they went stopping up all the fountains and the torrent that floods through the middle of the land, saying: “Why should the kings of As·syrʹi·a come and actually find a great deal of water?”

11880.label: 2 Chronicles 32:5
11880.text: Furthermore, he took courage and built up all the broken-down wall and raised towers upon it, and on the outside another wall, and repaired the Mound of the City of David, and made missiles in abundance and shields.

11881.label: 2 Chronicles 32:6
11881.text: And he proceeded to put military chiefs over the people and collect them to him at the public square of the gate of the city and speak to the heart of them, saying:

11882.label: 2 Chronicles 32:7
11882.text: “Be courageous and strong. Do not be afraid nor be terrified because of the king of As·syrʹi·a and on account of all the crowd that is with him; for with us there are more than there are with him.
