11883.label: 2 Chronicles 32:8
11883.text: With him there is an arm of flesh, but with us there is Jehovah our God to help us and to fight our battles.” And the people began to brace themselves upon the words of Hez·e·kiʹah the king of Judah.

11884.label: 2 Chronicles 32:9
11884.text: It was after this that Sen·nachʹer·ib the king of As·syrʹi·a sent his servants to Jerusalem, while he was at Laʹchish and all his imperial might with him, to Hez·e·kiʹah the king of Judah and to all the Ju·deʹans that were in Jerusalem, saying:

11885.label: 2 Chronicles 32:10
11885.text: “This is what Sen·nachʹer·ib the king of As·syrʹi·a has said, ‘In what is it that YOU are trusting while sitting quiet under siege in Jerusalem?

11886.label: 2 Chronicles 32:11
11886.text: Is not Hez·e·kiʹah alluring YOU so as to give YOU over to die by famine and by thirst, saying: “Jehovah our God himself will deliver us out of the palm of the king of As·syrʹi·a”?

11887.label: 2 Chronicles 32:12
11887.text: Is it not Hez·e·kiʹah himself that removed his high places and his altars and then said to Judah and to Jerusalem: “Before one altar YOU should bow and upon it YOU should make sacrificial smoke”?

11888.label: 2 Chronicles 32:13
11888.text: Do YOU not know what I myself and my forefathers did to all the peoples of the lands? Did the gods of the nations of the lands at all prove able to deliver their land out of my hand?

11889.label: 2 Chronicles 32:14
11889.text: Who was there among all the gods of these nations that my forefathers devoted to destruction that proved able to deliver his people out of my hand, so that YOUR God should be able to deliver YOU out of my hand?

11890.label: 2 Chronicles 32:15
11890.text: And now do not let Hez·e·kiʹah deceive YOU or allure YOU like this and do not put faith in him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand and out of the hand of my forefathers. How much less, then, will YOUR own God deliver YOU out of my hand?’”

11891.label: 2 Chronicles 32:16
11891.text: And his servants spoke yet further against Jehovah the [true] God and against Hez·e·kiʹah his servant.

11892.label: 2 Chronicles 32:17
11892.text: Even letters he wrote to reproach Jehovah the God of Israel and to talk against him, saying: “Like the gods of the nations of the lands who did not deliver their people out of my hand, so the God of Hez·e·kiʹah will not deliver his people out of my hand.”

11893.label: 2 Chronicles 32:18
11893.text: And they kept calling with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem that were upon the wall, to make them afraid and to disturb them, in order that they might capture the city.

11894.label: 2 Chronicles 32:19
11894.text: And they went on speaking against the God of Jerusalem the same way as against the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of man’s hands.

11895.label: 2 Chronicles 32:20
11895.text: But Hez·e·kiʹah the king and Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz, the prophet, kept praying over this and crying to the heavens for aid.

11896.label: 2 Chronicles 32:21
11896.text: And Jehovah proceeded to send an angel and efface every valiant, mighty man and leader and chief in the camp of the king of As·syrʹi·a, so that he went back with shame of face to his own land. Later on he entered the house of his god and there certain ones that had come out of his own inward parts felled him with the sword.

11897.label: 2 Chronicles 32:22
11897.text: Thus Jehovah saved Hez·e·kiʹah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem out of the hand of Sen·nachʹer·ib the king of As·syrʹi·a and out of the hand of all others and gave them rest all around.

11898.label: 2 Chronicles 32:23
11898.text: And there were many bringing gifts to Jehovah at Jerusalem and choice things to Hez·e·kiʹah the king of Judah, and he came to be exalted in the eyes of all the nations after that.

11899.label: 2 Chronicles 32:24
11899.text: In those days Hez·e·kiʹah fell sick to the point of dying, and he began to pray to Jehovah. So He talked to him, and a portent He gave him.

11900.label: 2 Chronicles 32:25
11900.text: But according to the benefit rendered him Hez·e·kiʹah made no return, for his heart became haughty and there came to be indignation against him and against Judah and Jerusalem.

11901.label: 2 Chronicles 32:26
11901.text: However, Hez·e·kiʹah humbled himself for the haughtiness of his heart, he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and Jehovah’s indignation did not come upon them in the days of Hez·e·kiʹah.

11902.label: 2 Chronicles 32:27
11902.text: And Hez·e·kiʹah came to have riches and glory to a very great amount; and storehouses he made for himself for silver and for gold and for precious stones and for balsam oil and for shields and for all the desirable articles;

11903.label: 2 Chronicles 32:28
11903.text: and also storage places for the produce of grain and new wine and oil, and also stalls for all the different sorts of beasts and stalls for the droves.

11904.label: 2 Chronicles 32:29
11904.text: And cities he acquired for himself, and also livestock of the flock and of the herd in abundance; for God gave him very many goods.

11905.label: 2 Chronicles 32:30
11905.text: And Hez·e·kiʹah was the one that stopped up the upper source of the waters of Giʹhon and kept them directed straight along down to the west to the City of David, and Hez·e·kiʹah continued to prove successful in every work of his.

11906.label: 2 Chronicles 32:31
11906.text: And thus it was that by the spokesmen of the princes of Babylon that were sent to him to inquire about the portent that had happened in the land, the [true] God left him to put him to the test, to get to know everything in his heart.

11907.label: 2 Chronicles 32:32
11907.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Hez·e·kiʹah and his acts of loving-kindness, there they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Aʹmoz, in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

11908.label: 2 Chronicles 32:33
11908.text: Finally Hez·e·kiʹah lay down with his forefathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the burial places of the sons of David; and honor was what all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem rendered to him at his death. And Ma·nasʹseh his son began to reign in place of him.

11909.label: 2 Chronicles 33:1
11909.text: Twelve years old was Ma·nasʹseh when he began to reign, and for fifty-five years he reigned in Jerusalem.

11910.label: 2 Chronicles 33:2
11910.text: And he proceeded to do what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes, according to the detestable things of the nations that Jehovah had driven out from before the sons of Israel.

11911.label: 2 Chronicles 33:3
11911.text: So he built again the high places that Hez·e·kiʹah his father had pulled down, and set up altars to the Baʹals and made sacred poles, and he began to bow down to all the army of the heavens and serve them.

11912.label: 2 Chronicles 33:4
11912.text: And he built altars in the house of Jehovah, respecting which Jehovah had said: “In Jerusalem my name will prove to be to time indefinite.”

11913.label: 2 Chronicles 33:5
11913.text: And he went on to build altars to all the army of the heavens in two courtyards of the house of Jehovah.

11914.label: 2 Chronicles 33:6
11914.text: And he himself made his own sons pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinʹnom, and practiced magic and used divination and practiced sorcery and made spiritistic mediums and professional foretellers of events. He did on a grand scale what was bad in the eyes of Jehovah, to offend him.

11915.label: 2 Chronicles 33:7
11915.text: Furthermore, he put the carved image that he had made in the house of the [true] God, respecting which God had said to David and to Solʹo·mon his son: “In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I shall put my name to time indefinite.

11916.label: 2 Chronicles 33:8
11916.text: And I shall not remove the foot of Israel again from off the ground that I assigned to their forefathers, provided only that they take care to do all that I have commanded them concerning all the law and the regulations and the judicial decisions by the hand of Moses.”

11917.label: 2 Chronicles 33:9
11917.text: And Ma·nasʹseh kept seducing Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to do worse than the nations that Jehovah had annihilated from before the sons of Israel.

11918.label: 2 Chronicles 33:10
11918.text: And Jehovah kept speaking to Ma·nasʹseh and his people, but they paid no attention.

11919.label: 2 Chronicles 33:11
11919.text: Finally Jehovah brought against them the chiefs of the army that belonged to the king of As·syrʹi·a, and so they captured Ma·nasʹseh in the hollows and bound him with two fetters of copper and took him to Babylon.

11920.label: 2 Chronicles 33:12
11920.text: And as soon as it caused him distress, he softened the face of Jehovah his God and kept humbling himself greatly because of the God of his forefathers.

11921.label: 2 Chronicles 33:13
11921.text: And he kept praying to Him, so that He let himself be entreated by him and He heard his request for favor and restored him to Jerusalem to his kingship; and Ma·nasʹseh came to know that Jehovah is the [true] God.

11922.label: 2 Chronicles 33:14
11922.text: And after this he built an outer wall for the City of David to the west of Giʹhon in the torrent valley and as far as the Fish Gate, and he ran [it] around to Oʹphel and proceeded to make it very high. Further, he put chiefs of the military force in all the fortified cities in Judah.

11923.label: 2 Chronicles 33:15
11923.text: And he proceeded to remove the foreign gods and the idol image from the house of Jehovah and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the house of Jehovah and in Jerusalem and then had them thrown outside the city.

11924.label: 2 Chronicles 33:16
11924.text: Moreover, he prepared the altar of Jehovah and began to sacrifice upon it communion sacrifices and thanksgiving sacrifices and went on to say to Judah to serve Jehovah the God of Israel.

11925.label: 2 Chronicles 33:17
11925.text: Nevertheless, the people were still sacrificing upon the high places; only it was to Jehovah their God.

11926.label: 2 Chronicles 33:18
11926.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Ma·nasʹseh and his prayer to his God and the words of the visionaries that kept speaking to him in the name of Jehovah the God of Israel, there they are among the affairs of the kings of Israel.

11927.label: 2 Chronicles 33:19
11927.text: As for his prayer and how his entreaty was granted him and all his sin and his unfaithfulness and the locations in which he built high places and set up the sacred poles and the graven images before he humbled himself, there they are written among the words of his visionaries.

11928.label: 2 Chronicles 33:20
11928.text: Finally Ma·nasʹseh lay down with his forefathers, and they buried him at his house; and Aʹmon his son began to reign in place of him.

11929.label: 2 Chronicles 33:21
11929.text: Twenty-two years old was Aʹmon when he began to reign, and for two years he reigned in Jerusalem.

11930.label: 2 Chronicles 33:22
11930.text: And he proceeded to do what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes, just as Ma·nasʹseh his father had done; and to all the graven images that Ma·nasʹseh his father had made Aʹmon sacrificed, and he continued serving them.

11931.label: 2 Chronicles 33:23
11931.text: And he did not humble himself because of Jehovah the same as Ma·nasʹseh his father humbled himself, for Aʹmon was one that made guiltiness increase.

11932.label: 2 Chronicles 33:24
11932.text: Finally his servants conspired against him and put him to death in his own house.

11933.label: 2 Chronicles 33:25
11933.text: But the people of the land struck down all the conspirators against King Aʹmon, and the people of the land then made Jo·siʹah his son king in place of him.

11934.label: 2 Chronicles 34:1
11934.text: Eight years old was Jo·siʹah when he began to reign, and for thirty-one years he reigned in Jerusalem.

11935.label: 2 Chronicles 34:2
11935.text: And he proceeded to do what was right in Jehovah’s eyes and walk in the ways of David his forefather; and he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.

11936.label: 2 Chronicles 34:3
11936.text: And in the eighth year of his reigning, while he was still a boy, he started to search for the God of David his forefather; and in the twelfth year he started to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem from the high places and the sacred poles and the graven images and the molten statues.

11937.label: 2 Chronicles 34:4
11937.text: Further, they pulled down before him the altars of the Baʹals; and the incense stands that were up above he cut down from off them; and the sacred poles and the graven images and the molten statues he broke in pieces and reduced to powder, and then sprinkled [it] upon the surface of the burial places of those that used to sacrifice to them.

11938.label: 2 Chronicles 34:5
11938.text: And the bones of priests he burned upon their altars. Thus he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

11939.label: 2 Chronicles 34:6
11939.text: Also, in the cities of Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im and Simʹe·on and clear to Naphʹta·li, in their devastated places all around,

11940.label: 2 Chronicles 34:7
11940.text: he even went pulling down the altars and the sacred poles, and the graven images he crushed and reduced to powder; and all the incense stands he cut down in all the land of Israel, after which he returned to Jerusalem.

11941.label: 2 Chronicles 34:8
11941.text: And in the eighteenth year of his reigning, when he had cleansed the land and the house, he sent Shaʹphan the son of Az·a·liʹah and Ma·a·seiʹah the chief of the city and Joʹah the son of Joʹa·haz the recorder to repair the house of Jehovah his God.

11942.label: 2 Chronicles 34:9
11942.text: And they proceeded to come to Hil·kiʹah the high priest and give the money that was being brought to the house of God, which the Levites the doorkeepers had gathered from the hand of Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im and from all the rest of Israel and from all Judah and Benjamin and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

11943.label: 2 Chronicles 34:10
11943.text: Then they put [it] into the hand of the doers of the work that were appointed over the house of Jehovah. In turn the doers of the work who were active in the house of Jehovah applied it to mending and repairing the house.

11944.label: 2 Chronicles 34:11
11944.text: So they gave it to the craftsmen and the builders to buy hewn stones and timbers for clamps and to build with beams the houses that the kings of Judah had brought to ruin.

11945.label: 2 Chronicles 34:12
11945.text: And the men were acting in faithfulness in the work; and over them there were appointed Jaʹhath and O·ba·diʹah the Levites, from the sons of Me·rarʹi, and Zech·a·riʹah and Me·shulʹlam, from the sons of the Koʹhath·ites, to act as overseers. And the Levites, each of whom was expert with the instruments of song,

11946.label: 2 Chronicles 34:13
11946.text: were over the burden bearers, and the overseers of all the doers of the work for the different services; and from the Levites there were secretaries and officers and gatekeepers.

11947.label: 2 Chronicles 34:14
11947.text: Now while they were bringing out the money that was being brought to the house of Jehovah, Hil·kiʹah the priest found the book of Jehovah’s law by the hand of Moses.

11948.label: 2 Chronicles 34:15
11948.text: So Hil·kiʹah answered and said to Shaʹphan the secretary: “The very book of the law I have found in the house of Jehovah.” With that Hil·kiʹah gave the book to Shaʹphan.

11949.label: 2 Chronicles 34:16
11949.text: Then Shaʹphan brought the book to the king and replied further to the king, saying: “All that has been put in the hand of your servants they are doing.

11950.label: 2 Chronicles 34:17
11950.text: And they pour out the money that is found in the house of Jehovah and put it in the hand of the appointed men and into the hand of the doers of the work.”

11951.label: 2 Chronicles 34:18
11951.text: And Shaʹphan the secretary went on to report to the king, saying: “There is a book that Hil·kiʹah the priest gave me.” And Shaʹphan began to read out of it before the king.

11952.label: 2 Chronicles 34:19
11952.text: And it came about that as soon as the king heard the words of the law, he immediately ripped his garments apart.

11953.label: 2 Chronicles 34:20
11953.text: Then the king commanded Hil·kiʹah and A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan and Abʹdon the son of Miʹcah and Shaʹphan the secretary and A·saiʹah the king’s servant, saying:

11954.label: 2 Chronicles 34:21
11954.text: “Go, inquire of Jehovah in my own behalf and in behalf of what is left in Israel and in Judah concerning the words of the book that has been found, for great is Jehovah’s rage that must be poured out against us because of the fact that our forefathers did not keep the word of Jehovah by doing according to all that is written in this book.”

11955.label: 2 Chronicles 34:22
11955.text: Accordingly Hil·kiʹah along with those whom the king [had said] went to Hulʹdah the prophetess, the wife of Shalʹlum the son of Tikʹvah the son of Harʹhas the caretaker of the garments, as she was dwelling in Jerusalem in the second quarter; and they proceeded to speak to her like this.

11956.label: 2 Chronicles 34:23
11956.text: In turn she said to them: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘SAY to the man that sent YOU to me:

11957.label: 2 Chronicles 34:24
11957.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am bringing calamity upon this place and its inhabitants, all the curses that are written in the book that they read before the king of Judah,

11958.label: 2 Chronicles 34:25
11958.text: due to the fact that they have left me and gone making sacrificial smoke to other gods, in order to offend me with all the doings of their hands and that my rage may pour forth upon this place and not be extinguished.’”

11959.label: 2 Chronicles 34:26
11959.text: And to the king of Judah, who is sending YOU to inquire of Jehovah, this is what YOU should say to him: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘As regards the words that you have heard,

11960.label: 2 Chronicles 34:27
11960.text: for the reason that your heart was soft so that you humbled yourself because of God at your hearing his words concerning this place and its inhabitants, and you humbled yourself before me and ripped your garments apart and wept before me, I, even I, have heard, is the utterance of Jehovah.

11961.label: 2 Chronicles 34:28
11961.text: Here I am gathering you to your forefathers, and you will certainly be gathered to your graveyard in peace, and your eyes will not look upon all the calamity that I am bringing upon this place and its inhabitants.’”’” Then they brought the reply to the king.

11962.label: 2 Chronicles 34:29
11962.text: And the king proceeded to send and gather all the older men of Judah and of Jerusalem.

11963.label: 2 Chronicles 34:30
11963.text: The king now went up to the house of Jehovah with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the priests and the Levites and all the people, the great as well as the small; and he began to read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant, which had been found at the house of Jehovah.

11964.label: 2 Chronicles 34:31
11964.text: And the king kept standing in his place and proceeded to conclude the covenant before Jehovah to go following Jehovah and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his regulations with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

11965.label: 2 Chronicles 34:32
11965.text: Furthermore, he had all those who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to take their stand [to it]. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem proceeded to do according to the covenant of God, the God of their forefathers.

11966.label: 2 Chronicles 34:33
11966.text: After that Jo·siʹah removed all the detestable things out of all the lands that belonged to the sons of Israel, and he had all who were found in Israel take up service, to serve Jehovah their God. All his days they did not turn aside from following Jehovah the God of their forefathers.

11967.label: 2 Chronicles 35:1
11967.text: Then Jo·siʹah held in Jerusalem a passover to Jehovah and they slaughtered the passover victim on the fourteenth day of the first month.

11968.label: 2 Chronicles 35:2
11968.text: So he stationed the priests over the things under their care and encouraged them in the service of the house of Jehovah.

11969.label: 2 Chronicles 35:3
11969.text: And he went on to say to the Levites, the instructors of all Israel, those holy to Jehovah: “Put the holy Ark in the house that Solʹo·mon the son of David the king of Israel built; it is not YOURS as a burden upon the shoulder. Now serve Jehovah YOUR God and his people Israel.

11970.label: 2 Chronicles 35:4
11970.text: And make preparation by the house of YOUR forefathers according to YOUR divisions, by the writing of David the king of Israel and by the writing of Solʹo·mon his son.

11971.label: 2 Chronicles 35:5
11971.text: And stand in the holy place by the classes of the house of the forefathers for YOUR brothers, the sons of the people, and the portion of a paternal house belonging to the Levites.

11972.label: 2 Chronicles 35:6
11972.text: And slaughter the passover victim and sanctify yourselves and make preparation for YOUR brothers to do according to the word of Jehovah by means of Moses.”

11973.label: 2 Chronicles 35:7
11973.text: Jo·siʹah now contributed to the sons of the people flocks, male lambs and male kids, the whole for the passover victims for all who were to be found, to the number of thirty thousand, and cattle, three thousand. These were from the goods of the king.

11974.label: 2 Chronicles 35:8
11974.text: And his princes themselves made a contribution as a voluntary offering for the people, for the priests and for the Levites. Hil·kiʹah and Zech·a·riʹah and Je·hiʹel themselves as leaders of the house of the [true] God gave to the priests for the passover victims two thousand six hundred, and three hundred cattle.

11975.label: 2 Chronicles 35:9
11975.text: And Con·a·niʹah and She·maiʹah and Ne·thanʹel his brothers and Hash·a·biʹah and Je·iʹel and Joʹza·bad, the chiefs of the Levites, contributed to the Levites for passover victims five thousand, and five hundred cattle.

11976.label: 2 Chronicles 35:10
11976.text: And the service was prepared and the priests kept standing at their places, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

11977.label: 2 Chronicles 35:11
11977.text: And they proceeded to slaughter the passover victim and the priests sprinkled [the blood] from their hand, while the Levites were stripping the skins off.

11978.label: 2 Chronicles 35:12
11978.text: Further, they prepared the burnt offerings so as to give them to the classes by the paternal house, to the sons of the people, so as to make a presentation to Jehovah according to what is written in the book of Moses; and thus also with the cattle.

11979.label: 2 Chronicles 35:13
11979.text: And they went boiling the passover offering over the fire according to the custom; and the things made holy they boiled in cooking pots and in round-bottomed pots and in banquet bowls, after which they brought it quickly to all the sons of the people.

11980.label: 2 Chronicles 35:14
11980.text: And afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were engaged in offering up the burnt sacrifices and the fat pieces until night, and the Levites, for their part, prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

11981.label: 2 Chronicles 35:15
11981.text: And the singers the sons of Aʹsaph were at their office according to the commandment of David and of Aʹsaph and of Heʹman and of Je·duʹthun the visionary of the king; and the gatekeepers were at the different gates. There was no need for them to turn aside from their service, because their brothers the Levites themselves prepared for them.

11982.label: 2 Chronicles 35:16
11982.text: And all the service of Jehovah was prepared on that day to hold the passover and to offer up the burnt offerings upon the altar of Jehovah, according to the commandment of King Jo·siʹah.

11983.label: 2 Chronicles 35:17
11983.text: And the sons of Israel that were to be found proceeded to hold the passover at that time and also the festival of the unfermented cakes for seven days.

11984.label: 2 Chronicles 35:18
11984.text: And there had never been held a passover like it in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet, neither had any of the other kings of Israel themselves held a passover like that which Jo·siʹah and the priests and the Levites and all Judah and Israel that were to be found and the inhabitants of Jerusalem held.

11985.label: 2 Chronicles 35:19
11985.text: In the eighteenth year of Jo·siʹah’s reign this passover was held.

11986.label: 2 Chronicles 35:20
11986.text: After all this when Jo·siʹah had prepared the house, Neʹcho the king of Egypt came up to fight at Carʹche·mish by the Eu·phraʹtes. Then Jo·siʹah went out to an encounter with him.

11987.label: 2 Chronicles 35:21
11987.text: At that he sent messengers to him, saying: “What do I have to do with you, O king of Judah? It is not against you that I am coming today, but it is against another house that my fight is and that God himself said that I should cause disturbance. Refrain for your own sake because of God, who is with me, and do not let him bring you to ruin.”

11988.label: 2 Chronicles 35:22
11988.text: And Jo·siʹah did not turn his face away from him, but to fight against him he disguised himself and did not listen to the words of Neʹcho from the mouth of God. So he came to fight in the valley plain of Me·gidʹdo.

11989.label: 2 Chronicles 35:23
11989.text: And the shooters got to shoot at King Jo·siʹah, so that the king said to his servants: “Take me down, for I have been very severely wounded.”

11990.label: 2 Chronicles 35:24
11990.text: Accordingly his servants took him down from the chariot and had him ride in the second war chariot that was his and brought him to Jerusalem. Thus he died and was buried in the graveyard of his forefathers; and all Judah and Jerusalem were mourning over Jo·siʹah.

11991.label: 2 Chronicles 35:25
11991.text: And Jeremiah began to chant over Jo·siʹah; and all the male singers and female singers keep talking about Jo·siʹah in their dirges down till today; and they have them set as a regulation over Israel, and there they are written among the dirges.

11992.label: 2 Chronicles 35:26
11992.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Jo·siʹah and his acts of loving-kindness, according to what is written in the law of Jehovah,

11993.label: 2 Chronicles 35:27
11993.text: and his affairs, the first and the last, there they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.

11994.label: 2 Chronicles 36:1
11994.text: Then the people of the land took Je·hoʹa·haz the son of Jo·siʹah and made him king in the place of his father in Jerusalem.

11995.label: 2 Chronicles 36:2
11995.text: Twenty-three years old was Je·hoʹa·haz when he began to reign, and for three months he reigned in Jerusalem.

11996.label: 2 Chronicles 36:3
11996.text: However, the king of Egypt removed him in Jerusalem and fined the land a hundred silver talents and a gold talent.

11997.label: 2 Chronicles 36:4
11997.text: Furthermore, the king of Egypt made E·liʹa·kim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem and changed his name to Je·hoiʹa·kim; but his brother Je·hoʹa·haz, Neʹcho took and brought to Egypt.

11998.label: 2 Chronicles 36:5
11998.text: Twenty-five years old was Je·hoiʹa·kim when he began to reign, and for eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem; and he continued to do what was bad in the eyes of Jehovah his God.

11999.label: 2 Chronicles 36:6
11999.text: Against him Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar the king of Babylon came up that he might bind him with two fetters of copper to carry him off to Babylon.

12000.label: 2 Chronicles 36:7
12000.text: And some of the utensils of the house of Jehovah Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar brought to Babylon and then put them in his palace in Babylon.

12001.label: 2 Chronicles 36:8
12001.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Je·hoiʹa·kim and his detestable things that he did and what was to be found against him, there they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah; and Je·hoiʹa·chin his son began to reign in place of him.

12002.label: 2 Chronicles 36:9
12002.text: Eighteen years old was Je·hoiʹa·chin when he began to reign, and for three months and ten days he reigned in Jerusalem; and he continued to do what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes.

12003.label: 2 Chronicles 36:10
12003.text: And at the return of the year King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar sent and proceeded to bring him to Babylon with desirable articles of the house of Jehovah. Further, he made Zed·e·kiʹah his [father’s] brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

12004.label: 2 Chronicles 36:11
12004.text: Twenty-one years old was Zed·e·kiʹah when he began to reign, and for eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem.

12005.label: 2 Chronicles 36:12
12005.text: And he continued to do what was bad in the eyes of Jehovah his God. He did not humble himself on account of Jeremiah the prophet at the order of Jehovah.

12006.label: 2 Chronicles 36:13
12006.text: And even against King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar he rebelled, who had made him swear by God; and he kept stiffening his neck and hardening his heart so as not to return to Jehovah the God of Israel.

12007.label: 2 Chronicles 36:14
12007.text: Even all the chiefs of the priests and the people themselves committed unfaithfulness on a large scale, according to all the detestable things of the nations, so that they defiled the house of Jehovah which he had sanctified in Jerusalem.

12008.label: 2 Chronicles 36:15
12008.text: And Jehovah the God of their forefathers kept sending against them by means of his messengers, sending again and again, because he felt compassion for his people and for his dwelling.

12009.label: 2 Chronicles 36:16
12009.text: But they were continually making jest at the messengers of the [true] God and despising his words and mocking at his prophets, until the rage of Jehovah came up against his people, until there was no healing.

12010.label: 2 Chronicles 36:17
12010.text: So he brought up against them the king of the Chal·deʹans, who proceeded to kill their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, neither did he feel compassion for young man or virgin, old or decrepit. Everything He gave into his hand.

12011.label: 2 Chronicles 36:18
12011.text: And all the utensils, great and small, of the house of the [true] God and the treasures of the house of Jehovah and the treasures of the king and of his princes, everything he brought to Babylon.

12012.label: 2 Chronicles 36:19
12012.text: And he proceeded to burn the house of the [true] God and pull down the wall of Jerusalem; and all its dwelling towers they burned with fire and also all its desirable articles, so as to cause ruin.

12013.label: 2 Chronicles 36:20
12013.text: Furthermore, he carried off those remaining from the sword captive to Babylon, and they came to be servants to him and his sons until the royalty of Persia began to reign;

12014.label: 2 Chronicles 36:21
12014.text: to fulfill Jehovah’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had paid off its sabbaths. All the days of lying desolated it kept sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

12015.label: 2 Chronicles 36:22
12015.text: And in the first year of Cyrus the king of Persia, that Jehovah’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Jehovah roused the spirit of Cyrus the king of Persia, so that he caused a cry to pass through all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying:

12016.label: 2 Chronicles 36:23
12016.text: “This is what Cyrus the king of Persia has said, ‘All the kingdoms of the earth Jehovah the God of the heavens has given me, and he himself has commissioned me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among YOU of all his people, Jehovah his God be with him. So let him go up.’”
